 234 // Workaround for i810/815/845/855 Framebuffer bitmap corruption                                      234  // Workaround for i810/815/845/855 Framebuffer bitmap corruption                                  
 235 ///#define I810_FB_DUMMY_ACCESS                                                                       235  ///#define I810_FB_DUMMY_ACCESS                                                                   
 236                                                                                                       236                                                                                                    
 237 #ifdef ENABLE_8BPP                                                                                    237  #ifdef ENABLE_8BPP                                                                                
 238 #warning "ENABLE_8BPP"                                                                                238  #warning "ENABLE_8BPP"                                                                            
 239 /* 8 bpp */                                                                                           239  /* 8 bpp */                                                                                       
 240 PRIVATE cpal8_t pallete_idx_from_color_idx(u_char clr_idx)                                         |  240  PRIVATE cpal8_t palette_idx_from_color_idx(u_char clr_idx)                                        
 241 {                                                                                                     241  {                                                                                                 
 242     cpal8_t cpal8;                                                                                    242      cpal8_t cpal8;                                                                                
 243                                                                                                       243                                                                                                    
 244     // swap bit 2 and 0                                                                               244      // swap bit 2 and 0                                                                           
 245     cpal8 = (clr_idx & 0x0a)                                                                          245      cpal8 = (clr_idx & 0x0a)                                                                      
 246      | ((clr_idx & 0x01) << 2)  // bit 0 ==> bit 2                                                    246       | ((clr_idx & 0x01) << 2)  // bit 0 ==> bit 2                                                
 247      | ((clr_idx & 0x04) >> 2); // bit 2 ==> bit 0                                                    247       | ((clr_idx & 0x04) >> 2); // bit 2 ==> bit 0                                                
 248     return cpal8;                                                                                     248      return cpal8;                                                                                 
 249 }                                                                                                     249  }                                                                                                 
 250 #ifdef ENABLE_SCREEN_SHOT                                                                             250  #ifdef ENABLE_SCREEN_SHOT                                                                         
 251 PRIVATE u_char color_idx_from_pallete_idx(cpal8_t cpal8)                                           |  251  PRIVATE u_char color_idx_from_palette_idx(cpal8_t cpal8)                                          
 252 {                                                                                                     252  {                                                                                                 
 253     u_char clr_idx;                                                                                   253      u_char clr_idx;                                                                               
 254                                                                                                       254                                                                                                    
 255     // swap bit 2 and 0                                                                               255      // swap bit 2 and 0                                                                           
 256     clr_idx = (cpal8 & 0x0a)                                                                          256      clr_idx = (cpal8 & 0x0a)                                                                      
 257      | ((cpal8 & 0x01) << 2)    // bit 0 ==> bit 2                                                    257       | ((cpal8 & 0x01) << 2)    // bit 0 ==> bit 2                                                
 258      | ((cpal8 & 0x04) >> 2);   // bit 2 ==> bit 0                                                    258       | ((cpal8 & 0x04) >> 2);   // bit 2 ==> bit 0                                                
 259     return clr_idx;                                                                                   259      return clr_idx;                                                                               
 260 }                                                                                                     260  }                                                                                                 
 261 #endif // ENABLE_SCREEN_SHOT                                                                          261  #endif // ENABLE_SCREEN_SHOT                                                                      
 262 /* 8 bpp */                                                                                           262  /* 8 bpp */                                                                                       
 263 PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_clear_all(c_idx_t clr_idx, rgb15_t rgb15)                                        263  PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_clear_all(c_idx_t clr_idx, rgb15_t rgb15)                                    
 264 {                                                                                                     264  {                                                                                                 
 265     cpal8_t cpal8 = pallete_idx_from_color_idx(clr_idx);    //=                                    |  265      cpal8_t cpal8 = palette_idx_from_color_idx(clr_idx);    //=                                   
 266                                                                                                       266                                                                                                    
 267     memset(fb_start, cpal8, fb_size);                   //=bpp_clear_all                              267      memset(fb_start, cpal8, fb_size);                   //=bpp_clear_all                          
 268                                                                                                       268                                                                                                    
 269 }                                                                                                     269  }                                                                                                 
 270 PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_fill_char_box(u_short xx, u_short yy, bool wide,                                 270  PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_fill_char_box(u_short xx, u_short yy, bool wide,                             
 271  c_idx_t clr_idx, rgb15_t rgb15)                                                                      271   c_idx_t clr_idx, rgb15_t rgb15)                                                                  
 272 {                                                                                                     272  {                                                                                                 
 273     cpal8_t cpal8 = pallete_idx_from_color_idx(clr_idx);    //=                                    |  273      cpal8_t cpal8 = palette_idx_from_color_idx(clr_idx);    //=                                   
 274     u_char *fb_left = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;           274      u_char *fb_left = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;       
 275     u_char glyph_exp_width = fb_font_exp_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                        275      u_char glyph_exp_width = fb_font_exp_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                    
 276     for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_exp_size_hy; fy++) {                                             276      for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_exp_size_hy; fy++) {                                         
 277                                                                                                       277

 279         memset(fb_left, cpal8, fb_font_exp_size_hx);        //=bpp_fill_char_box                      279          memset(fb_left, cpal8, fb_font_exp_size_hx);        //=bpp_fill_char_box                  
 280                                                                                                       280                                                                                                    
 281                                                                                                       281                                                                                                    
 282         fb_left += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;                                                                  282          fb_left += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;                                                              
 283     }                                                                                                 283      }                                                                                             
 284 }                                                                                                     284  }                                                                                                 
 285 PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_reverse_char_box(u_short xx, u_short yy, bool wide,                              285  PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_reverse_char_box(u_short xx, u_short yy, bool wide,

 289     u_char *fb_left = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;           289      u_char *fb_left = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;       
 290     u_char glyph_exp_width = fb_font_exp_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                        290      u_char glyph_exp_width = fb_font_exp_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                    
 291     for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_exp_size_hy; fy++) {                                             291      for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_exp_size_hy; fy++) {                                         
 292         u_char *fb = fb_left;                                                                         292          u_char *fb = fb_left;                                                                     
 293         for (u_char fx = 0; fx < glyph_exp_width; fx++) {                                             293          for (u_char fx = 0; fx < glyph_exp_width; fx++) {

 297         fb_left += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;                                                                  297          fb_left += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;

 300     fb_left = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;                   300      fb_left = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;               
 301     for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_exp_size_hy; fy++) {                                             301      for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_exp_size_hy; fy++) {                                         
 302         *(volatile cpal8_t*)fb_left = *(volatile cpal8_t*)fb_left;      //=                           302          *(volatile cpal8_t*)fb_left = *(volatile cpal8_t*)fb_left;      //=                       
 303         fb_left += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;                                                                  303          fb_left += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;

 307 PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_paint_char_box(u_short xx, u_short yy, wchar_t ucs21, bool wide,                 307  PRIVATE void fb_8bpp_paint_char_box(u_short xx, u_short yy, wchar_t ucs21, bool wide,             
 308  c_idx_t bc_idx, c_idx_t fc_idx, rgb15_t bc_rgb15, rgb15_t fc_rgb15)                                  308   c_idx_t bc_idx, c_idx_t fc_idx, rgb15_t bc_rgb15, rgb15_t fc_rgb15)                              
 309 {                                                                                                     309  {                                                                                                 
 310     cpal8_t bcpal8 = pallete_idx_from_color_idx(bc_idx);    //=                                    |  310      cpal8_t bcpal8 = palette_idx_from_color_idx(bc_idx);    //=                                   
 311     cpal8_t fcpal8 = pallete_idx_from_color_idx(fc_idx);    //=                                    |  311      cpal8_t fcpal8 = palette_idx_from_color_idx(fc_idx);    //=                                   
 312     u_char glyph_width = fb_font_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                                312      u_char glyph_width = fb_font_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                            
 313     const u_short *glyph = font_set_glyph(ucs21, 0);                                                  313      const u_short *glyph = font_set_glyph(ucs21, 0);                                              
 314     u_char *fb_chr_y = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;          314      u_char *fb_chr_y = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;      
 315     for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_size_hy; fy++) {                                                 315      for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_size_hy; fy++) {                                             
 316         u_char *fb_chr_x = fb_chr_y;                                                                  316          u_char *fb_chr_x = fb_chr_y;                                                              
 317         u_short bitmap = *glyph;                                                                      317          u_short bitmap = *glyph;                                                                  
 318         u_short bit_mask = 0x8000;                                                                    318          u_short bit_mask = 0x8000;                                                                
 319         for (u_char fx = 0; fx < glyph_width; fx++) {                                                 319          for (u_char fx = 0; fx < glyph_width; fx++) {                                             
 320             u_char *fb_dot_y = fb_chr_x;                                                              320              u_char *fb_dot_y = fb_chr_x;                                                          
 321             cpal8_t cpal8 = (bitmap & bit_mask) ? fcpal8 : bcpal8;                              //    321              cpal8_t cpal8 = (bitmap & bit_mask) ? fcpal8 : bcpal8;                              //
 322             for (u_char mul_y = 0; mul_y < fb_font_mul_hy; mul_y++) {                                 322              for (u_char mul_y = 0; mul_y < fb_font_mul_hy; mul_y++) {                             
 323                 u_char *fb_dot_x = fb_dot_y;                                                          323                  u_char *fb_dot_x = fb_dot_y;                                                      
 324                 for (u_char mul_x = 0; mul_x < fb_font_mul_hx; mul_x++) {                             324                  for (u_char mul_x = 0; mul_x < fb_font_mul_hx; mul_x++) {                         
 325                     *(cpal8_t *)fb_dot_x = cpal8;               //=bpp_paint_char_box                 325                      *(cpal8_t *)fb_dot_x = cpal8;               //=bpp_paint_char_box             
 326                     fb_dot_x += fbr_bytes_inc_hx;                                                     326                      fb_dot_x += fbr_bytes_inc_hx;                                                 
 327                 }                                                                                     327                  }                                                                                 
 328                 fb_dot_y += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;                                                         328                  fb_dot_y += fbr_bytes_inc_hy;                                                     
 329             }                                                                                         329              }                                                                                     
 330             bit_mask >>= 1;                                                                           330              bit_mask >>= 1;                                                                       
 331             fb_chr_x += fbr_bytes_inc_dot_hx;                                                         331              fb_chr_x += fbr_bytes_inc_dot_hx;                                                     
 332         }                                                                                             332          }                                                                                         
 333         glyph++;                                                                                      333          glyph++;                                                                                  
 334         fb_chr_y += fbr_bytes_inc_dot_hy;                                                             334          fb_chr_y += fbr_bytes_inc_dot_hy;                                                         
 335     }                                                                                                 335      }                                                                                             
 336 }                                                                                                     336  }

 662  c_idx_t bc_idx, c_idx_t fc_idx, rgb15_t bc_rgb15, rgb15_t fc_rgb15)                                  662   c_idx_t bc_idx, c_idx_t fc_idx, rgb15_t bc_rgb15, rgb15_t fc_rgb15)                              
 663 {                                                                                                     663  {                                                                                                 
 664     argb32_t bc_argb32 = argb32_from_rgb15(bc_rgb15);       //=                                       664      argb32_t bc_argb32 = argb32_from_rgb15(bc_rgb15);       //=                                   
 665     argb32_t fc_argb32 = argb32_from_rgb15(fc_rgb15);       //=                                       665      argb32_t fc_argb32 = argb32_from_rgb15(fc_rgb15);       //=                                   
 666     u_char glyph_width = fb_font_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                                666      u_char glyph_width = fb_font_size_hx * (1 + wide);                                            
 667     const u_short *glyph = font_set_glyph(ucs21, 0);                                                  667      const u_short *glyph = font_set_glyph(ucs21, 0);                                              
 668     u_char *fb_chr_y = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;          668      u_char *fb_chr_y = fbr_origin + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hy * yy + fbr_bytes_inc_font_hx * xx;      
 669     for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_size_hy; fy++) {                                                 669      for (u_char fy = 0; fy < fb_font_size_hy; fy++) {                                             
 670         u_char *fb_chr_x = fb_chr_y;                                                                  670          u_char *fb_chr_x = fb_chr_y;                                                              
 671         u_short bitmap = *glyph;                                                                      671          u_short bitmap = *glyph;                                                                  
 672         u_short bit_mask = 0x8000;                                                                    672          u_short bit_mask = 0x8000;                                                                
 673         for (u_char fx = 0; fx < glyph_width; fx++) {                                                 673          for (u_char fx = 0; fx < glyph_width; fx++) {                                             
 674             u_char *fb_dot_y = fb_chr_x;                                                              674              u_char *fb_dot_y = fb_chr_x;                                                          
 675             argb32_t argb32 = (bitmap & bit_mask) ? fc_argb32 : bc_argb32;                      //    675              argb32_t argb32 = (bitmap & bit_mask) ? fc_argb32 : bc_argb32;                      //
 676             for (u_char mul_y = 0; mul_y < fb_font_mul_hy; mul_y++) {                                 676              for (u_char mul_y = 0; mul_y < fb_font_mul_hy; mul_y++) {                             
 677                 u_char *fb_dot_x = fb_dot_y;                                                          677                  u_char *fb_dot_x = fb_dot_y;

 687         glyph++;                                                                                      687          glyph++;

 136 int fb_open(frame_buffer_t *fb)                                                                       136  int fb_open(frame_buffer_t *fb)                                                                   
 137 {                                                                                                     137  {                                                                                                 
 138     struct stat st;                                                                                   138      struct stat st;

 140                                                                                                       140                                                                                                    
 141     if ((fb->fd_fb = util_privilege_open(fb->fb_dev_name, O_RDWR)) == -1) {                           141      if ((fb->fd_fb = util_privilege_open(fb->fb_dev_name, O_RDWR)) == -1) {

 143         se_printf("open %s", fb->fb_dev_name);                                                        143          se_printf("open %s", fb->fb_dev_name);                                                    
 144         return -1;                                                                                    144          return -1;

 441 // rgb16_t <== r, g, b                                                                                441  // rgb16_t <== r, g, b                                                                            
 442 rgb16_t rgb16_from_r_g_b_24(u_char rr, u_char gg, u_char bb)                                          442  rgb16_t rgb16_from_r_g_b_24(u_char rr, u_char gg, u_char bb)

 447 argb32_t argb32_from_r_g_b_24(u_char rr, u_char gg, u_char bb)                                        447  argb32_t argb32_from_r_g_b_24(u_char rr, u_char gg, u_char bb)                                    
 448 {                                                                                                     448  {                                                                                                 
 449     return (((u_int32)rr) << 16) | (gg << 8) | bb;                                                    449      return (((u_int32)rr) << 16) | (gg << 8) | bb;

 451 //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------                       451  //-----------------------------------------------------------------------------                   
 452 // rgb16_t <== rgb15_t                                                                                452  // rgb16_t <== rgb15_t                                                                            
 453 rgb16_t rgb16_from_rgb15(rgb15_t rgb15)                                                               453  rgb16_t rgb16_from_rgb15(rgb15_t rgb15)                                                           
 454 {                                                                                                     454  {                                                                                                 
 455     //     5432109876543210                                                                           455      //     5432109876543210                                                                       
 456     //     0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                                           456      //     0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                                       
 457     // ==> RRRRRGGGGGgBBBBB                                                                           457      // ==> RRRRRGGGGGgBBBBB                                                                       
 458     return ((rgb15 << 1) & 0xffe0) | (rgb15 & 0x1f);                                                  458      return ((rgb15 << 1) & 0xffe0) | (rgb15 & 0x1f);                                              
 459 }                                                                                                     459  }                                                                                                 
 460 // argb32_t <== rgb15_t                                                                               460  // argb32_t <== rgb15_t                                                                           
 461 argb32_t argb32_from_rgb15(rgb15_t rgb15)                                                             461  argb32_t argb32_from_rgb15(rgb15_t rgb15)                                                         
 462 {                                                                                                     462  {                                                                                                 
 463     //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                           463      //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                       
 464     //                     0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                           464      //                     0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                       
 465     // ==> aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGgggBBBBBbbb                                                           465      // ==> aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGgggBBBBBbbb                                                       
 466     return ((((u_int32)rgb15) << 9) & 0x00f80000UL)                                                   466      return ((((u_int32)rgb15) << 9) & 0x00f80000UL)                                               
 467                     | ((rgb15 << 6) & 0x0000f800UL)                                                   467                      | ((rgb15 << 6) & 0x0000f800UL)                                               
 468                     | ((rgb15 << 3) & 0x000000f8UL);                                                  468                      | ((rgb15 << 3) & 0x000000f8UL);                                              
 469 }                                                                                                     469  }                                                                                                 
 470 // rgb15_t <== rgb16_t                                                                                470  // rgb15_t <== rgb16_t                                                                            
 471 rgb15_t rgb15_from_rgb16(rgb16_t rgb16)                                                               471  rgb15_t rgb15_from_rgb16(rgb16_t rgb16)                                                           
 472 {                                                                                                     472  {                                                                                                 
 473     //     5432109876543210                                                                           473      //     5432109876543210                                                                       
 474     //     RRRRRGGGGGgBBBBB                                                                           474      //     RRRRRGGGGGgBBBBB                                                                       
 475     // ==> 0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                                           475      // ==> 0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                                       
 476     return ((rgb16 >> 1) & 0x7fe0) | (rgb16 & 0x1f);                                                  476      return ((rgb16 >> 1) & 0x7fe0) | (rgb16 & 0x1f);                                              
 477 }                                                                                                     477  }                                                                                                 
 478 // argb32_t <== rgb16_t                                                                               478  // argb32_t <== rgb16_t                                                                           
 479 argb32_t argb32_from_rgb16(rgb15_t rgb16)                                                             479  argb32_t argb32_from_rgb16(rgb15_t rgb16)                                                         
 480 {                                                                                                     480  {                                                                                                 
 481     //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                           481      //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                       
 482     //                     RRRRRGGGGGGBBBBB                                                           482      //                     RRRRRGGGGGGBBBBB                                                       
 483     // ==> aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGGggBBBBBbbb                                                           483      // ==> aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGGggBBBBBbbb                                                       
 484     return ((((u_int32)rgb16) << 8) & 0x00f80000UL)                                                   484      return ((((u_int32)rgb16) << 8) & 0x00f80000UL)                                               
 485                     | ((rgb16 << 5) & 0x0000fc00UL)                                                   485                      | ((rgb16 << 5) & 0x0000fc00UL)                                               
 486                     | ((rgb16 << 3) & 0x000000f8UL);                                                  486                      | ((rgb16 << 3) & 0x000000f8UL);                                              
 487 }                                                                                                     487  }                                                                                                 
 488 // rgb15_t <== argb32_t                                                                               488  // rgb15_t <== argb32_t                                                                           
 489 rgb15_t rgb15_from_argb32(argb32_t argb32)                                                            489  rgb15_t rgb15_from_argb32(argb32_t argb32)                                                        
 490 {                                                                                                     490  {                                                                                                 
 491     //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                           491      //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                       
 492     //     aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGgggBBBBBbbb                                                           492      //     aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGgggBBBBBbbb                                                       
 493     //     ==>             0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                           493      //     ==>             0RRRRRGGGGGBBBBB                                                       
 494     return ((argb32 & 0xf80000) >> 9)                                                                 494      return ((argb32 & 0xf80000) >> 9)                                                             
 495         |  ((argb32 & 0x00f800) >> 6)                                                                 495          |  ((argb32 & 0x00f800) >> 6)                                                             
 496         |  ((argb32 & 0x0000f8) >> 3);                                                                496          |  ((argb32 & 0x0000f8) >> 3);                                                            
 497 }                                                                                                     497  }                                                                                                 
 498 // rgb16_t <== argb32_t                                                                               498  // rgb16_t <== argb32_t                                                                           
 499 rgb16_t rgb16_from_argb32(argb32_t argb32)                                                            499  rgb16_t rgb16_from_argb32(argb32_t argb32)                                                        
 500 {                                                                                                     500  {                                                                                                 
 501     //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                           501      //     10987654321098765432109876543210                                                       
 502     //     aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGGggBBBBBbbb                                                           502      //     aaaaaaaaRRRRRrrrGGGGGGggBBBBBbbb                                                       
 503     //     ==>             RRRRRGGGGGGBBBBB                                                           503      //     ==>             RRRRRGGGGGGBBBBB                                                       
 504     return ((argb32 & 0xf80000) >> 8)                                                                 504      return ((argb32 & 0xf80000) >> 8)                                                             
 505         |  ((argb32 & 0x00fc00) >> 5)                                                                 505          |  ((argb32 & 0x00fc00) >> 5)                                                             
 506         |  ((argb32 & 0x0000f8) >> 3);                                                                506          |  ((argb32 & 0x0000f8) >> 3);                                                            
 507 }                                                                                                     507  }

 592                                                                                                       592                                                                                                    
 593 const char *dump_rgb15(rgb15_t rgb15)                                                                 593  const char *dump_rgb15(rgb15_t rgb15)                                                             
 594 {                                                                                                     594  {                                                                                                 
 595     static int buf_idx = 0;                                                                           595      static int buf_idx = 0;                                                                       
 596     static char buffer[2][100+1];                                                                     596      static char buffer[2][100+1];                                                                 
 597                                                                                                       597                                                                                                    
 598     ++buf_idx;                                                                                        598      ++buf_idx;                                                                                    
 599     buf_idx = buf_idx % 2;      // 0, 1                                                               599      buf_idx = buf_idx % 2;      // 0, 1                                                           
 600     snprintf(buffer[buf_idx], 100+1, "(%02x, %02x, %02x)",                                            600      snprintf(buffer[buf_idx], 100+1, "(%02x, %02x, %02x)",                                        
 601      ((rgb15 >> 10) & 0x1f),                                                                          601       ((rgb15 >> 10) & 0x1f),                                                                      
 602      ((rgb15 >>  5) & 0x1f),                                                                          602       ((rgb15 >>  5) & 0x1f),                                                                      
 603      ((rgb15 >>  0) & 0x1f));                                                                         603       ((rgb15 >>  0) & 0x1f));                                                                     
 604     return buffer[buf_idx];                                                                           604      return buffer[buf_idx];                                                                       
 605 }                                                                                                     605  }                                                                                                 
 606                                                                                                       606

 449         width_in_pixels = font_get_adjacent_glyph_width_in_pixels(font, ucs21);                       449          width_in_pixels = font_get_adjacent_glyph_width_in_pixels(font, ucs21);                   
 450     }                                                                                                 450      }                                                                                             
 451     return width_in_pixels;                                                                           451      return width_in_pixels;                                                                       
 452 }                                                                                                     452  }

 454 const int font_get_adjacent_glyph_width_in_pixels(font_t *font, wchar_t ucs21)                        454  const int font_get_adjacent_glyph_width_in_pixels(font_t *font, wchar_t ucs21)                    
 455 {                                                                                                     455  {

 459     if (width_in_pixels == 0) {                                                                       459      if (width_in_pixels == 0) {                                                                   
 460         for (wchar_t ucs = (ucs21 & 0xffe0); ucs < (ucs21 | 0x001f); ucs++) {                         460          for (wchar_t ucs = (ucs21 & 0xffe0); ucs < (ucs21 | 0x001f); ucs++) {                     
 461             width_in_pixels = MAX_(width_in_pixels, font->glyph_width[ucs]);                          461              width_in_pixels = MAX_(width_in_pixels, font->glyph_width[ucs]);                      
 462         }                                                                                             462          }                                                                                         
 463     }                                                                                                 463      }                                                                                             
 464     return width_in_pixels;                                                                           464      return width_in_pixels;                                                                       
 465 }                                                                                                     465  }

  40 // 5x10 "0000:0000A010801080500000"                                                                    40  // 5x10 "0000:0000A010801080500000"

  48 #define HEX_CODE_LEN    5       // "3000:"                                                             48  #define HEX_CODE_LEN    5       // "3000:"                                                        
  49 int hex_load(font_t *font, char *file_path)                                                            49  int hex_load(font_t *font, char *file_path)                                                       
  50 {                                                                                                      50  {                                                                                                 
  51 #define MAX_LINE_LEN    100                                                                            51  #define MAX_LINE_LEN    100                                                                       
  52     char filter[MAX_LINE_LEN+1];                                                                       52      char filter[MAX_LINE_LEN+1];                                                                  
  53     FILE *fp;                                                                                          53      FILE *fp;                                                                                     
  54     char buffer[MAX_LINE_LEN+1];                                                                       54      char buffer[MAX_LINE_LEN+1];                                                                  
  55     int char_code;                                                                                     55      int char_code;                                                                                
  56     u_short *bitmap_ptr;                                                                               56      u_short *bitmap_ptr;                                                                          
  57     int len;                                                                                           57      int len;                                                                                      
  58     int off;                                                                                           58      int off;                                                                                      
  59     long bitmap;                                                                                       59      long bitmap;                                                                                  
  60     int lines;                                                                                         60      int lines;                                                                                    
  61     int height;                                                                                        61      int height;                                                                                   
  62     int width;                                                                                         62      int width;                                                                                    
  63     int digits;                                                                                        63      int digits;                                                                                   
  64                                                                                                        64                                                                                                    
  65     v_printf("Loading font file: %s ...\n", file_path);                                                65      v_printf("Loading font file: %s ...\n", file_path);                                           
  66     filter[0] = '\0';                                                                                  66      filter[0] = '\0';                                                                             
  67     if (strlen(file_path) > 3                                                                          67      if (strlen(file_path) > 3                                                                     
  68      && strcmp(".gz", &file_path[strlen(file_path)-3]) == 0) {                                         68       && strcmp(".gz", &file_path[strlen(file_path)-3]) == 0) {                                    
  69         snprintf(filter, MAX_LINE_LEN+1, "zcat \"%s\" 2>/dev/null", file_path);                        69          snprintf(filter, MAX_LINE_LEN+1, "zcat \"%s\" 2>/dev/null", file_path);                   
  70         if ((fp = popen(filter, "r")) <= 0) {                                                          70          if ((fp = popen(filter, "r")) <= 0) {                                                     
  71             return 1;                                                                                  71              return 1;                                                                             
  72         }                                                                                              72          }                                                                                         
  73     } else {                                                                                           73      } else {                                                                                      
  74         if ((fp = fopen(file_path, "r")) == NULL) {                                                    74          if ((fp = fopen(file_path, "r")) == NULL) {                                               
  75             return 1;                                                                                  75              return 1;                                                                             
  76         }                                                                                              76          }                                                                                         
  77     }                                                                                                  77      }                                                                                             
  78     lines = 0;                                                                                         78      lines = 0;                                                                                    
  79     for ( ; ; ) {                                                                                      79      for ( ; ; ) {                                                                                 
  80         if (fgets(buffer, MAX_LINE_LEN, fp) == NULL) {                                                 80          if (fgets(buffer, MAX_LINE_LEN, fp) == NULL) {                                            
  81             break;                                                                                     81              break;                                                                                
  82         }                                                                                              82          }                                                                                         
  83 //flf_d_printf("<%s", buffer);                                                                         83  //flf_d_printf("<%s", buffer);                                                                    
  84         char_code = get_hex_n_digits(buffer, 4);                                                       84          char_code = get_hex_n_digits(buffer, 4);                                                  
  85         if (char_code >= 0) {                                                                          85          if (char_code >= 0) {                                                                     
  86             lines++;                                                                                   86              lines++;                                                                              
  87             bitmap_ptr = font->glyph_bitmap[char_code];                                                87              bitmap_ptr = font->glyph_bitmap[char_code];                                           
  88             len = strlen(buffer)-1;                                                                    88              len = strlen(buffer)-1;                                                               
  89             len = MIN_(len-HEX_CODE_LEN, MAX_FONT_HEIGHT * 2 * 2);                                     89              len = MIN_(len-HEX_CODE_LEN, MAX_FONT_HEIGHT * 2 * 2);                                
  90 //flf_d_printf("len:%d, height:%d\n", len, height);                                                    90  //flf_d_printf("len:%d, height:%d\n", len, height);                                               
  91             if ((len / 2) <= MAX_FONT_HEIGHT) {                                                        91              if ((len / 2) <= MAX_FONT_HEIGHT) {                                                   
  92                 // narrow                                                                              92                  // narrow                                                                         
  93                 digits = 2;                                                                            93                  digits = 2;                                                                       
  94                 height = len / digits;                                                                 94                  height = len / digits;                                                            
  95                 width = height / 2;                                                                    95                  width = height / 2;                                                               
  96                 font->width = width;                                                                   96                  font->width = width;                                                              
  97                 font->height = height;                                                                 97                  font->height = height;                                                            
  98             } else {                                                                                   98              } else {                                                                              
  99                 // wide character                                                                      99                  // wide character                                                                 
 100                 digits = 4;                                                                           100                  digits = 4;                                                                       
 101                 height = len / digits;                                                                101                  height = len / digits;                                                            
 102                 width = height;                                                                       102                  width = height;                                                                   
 103             }                                                                                         103              }                                                                                     
 104             for (off = 0; off < len; off += digits) {                                                 104              for (off = 0; off < len; off += digits) {                                             
 105                 bitmap = get_hex_n_digits(&buffer[HEX_CODE_LEN+off], digits);                         105                  bitmap = get_hex_n_digits(&buffer[HEX_CODE_LEN+off], digits);                     
 106                 if (bitmap < 0)                                                                       106                  if (bitmap < 0)                                                                   
 107                     break;                                                                            107                      break;                                                                        
 108                 *bitmap_ptr++ = (u_short)bitmap;                                                      108                  *bitmap_ptr++ = (u_short)bitmap;                                                  
 109             }                                                                                         109              }                                                                                     
 110 //flf_d_printf("%04x:width:%d, height:%d\n", char_code, width, height);                               110  //flf_d_printf("%04x:width:%d, height:%d\n", char_code, width, height);                           
 111             font->glyph_width[char_code] = width;                                                     111              font->glyph_width[char_code] = width;                                                 
 112         }                                                                                             112          }                                                                                         
 113     }                                                                                                 113      }                                                                                             
 114     if (filter[0]) {                                                                                  114      if (filter[0]) {                                                                              
 115         if (pclose(fp) < 0) {                                                                         115          if (pclose(fp) < 0) {                                                                     
 116             _FL_                                                                                      116              _FL_                                                                                  
 117             return 2;                                                                                 117              return 2;                                                                             
 118         }                                                                                             118          }                                                                                         
 119     } else {                                                                                          119      } else {                                                                                      
 120         if (fclose(fp) < 0) {                                                                         120          if (fclose(fp) < 0) {                                                                     
 121             _FL_                                                                                      121              _FL_                                                                                  
 122             return 2;                                                                                 122              return 2;                                                                             
 123         }                                                                                             123          }                                                                                         
 124     }                                                                                                 124      }                                                                                             
 125     if (lines == 0) {                                                                                 125      if (lines == 0) {                                                                             
 126         return 3;                                                                                     126          return 3;                                                                                 
 127     }                                                                                                 127      }                                                                                             
 128     v_printf("OK\n");                                                                                 128      v_printf("OK\n");                                                                             
 129 ///flf_d_printf("width:%d, height:%d\n", font->width, font->height);                                  129  ///flf_d_printf("width:%d, height:%d\n", font->width, font->height);                              
 130     return 0;                                                                                         130      return 0;                                                                                     
 131 }                                                                                                     131  }

 133 PRIVATE long get_hex_n_digits(char *buffer, int digits)                                               133  PRIVATE long get_hex_n_digits(char *buffer, int digits)                                           
 134 {                                                                                                     134  {                                                                                                 
 135     long hex;                                                                                         135      long hex;                                                                                     
 136     int digit;                                                                                        136      int digit;                                                                                    
 137     char chr;                                                                                         137      char chr;                                                                                     
 138                                                                                                       138                                                                                                    
 139 #if 0                                                                                                 139  #if 0                                                                                             
 140     // sscanf( , "%0?x", ) is too slow                                                                140      // sscanf( , "%0?x", ) is too slow                                                            
 141     if (digits == 4) {                                                                                141      if (digits == 4) {                                                                            
 142         if (sscanf(buffer, "%04x", &hex) > 0)                                                         142          if (sscanf(buffer, "%04x", &hex) > 0)                                                     
 143             return hex;                                                                               143              return hex;                                                                           
 144     } else if (digits == 2) {                                                                         144      } else if (digits == 2) {                                                                     
 145         if (sscanf(buffer, "%02x", &hex) > 0)                                                         145          if (sscanf(buffer, "%02x", &hex) > 0)                                                     
 146             return hex;                                                                               146              return hex;                                                                           
 147     }                                                                                                 147      }                                                                                             
 148     return -1;                                                                                        148      return -1;                                                                                    
 149 #else                                                                                                 149  #else                                                                                             
 150     // fast replacement of sscanf(str, "%0?x", &hex)                                                  150      // fast replacement of sscanf(str, "%0?x", &hex)                                              
 151     hex = 0;                                                                                          151      hex = 0;                                                                                      
 152     for (digit = 0; digit < MIN_(4, digits); digit++) {                                               152      for (digit = 0; digit < MIN_(4, digits); digit++) {                                           
 153         hex <<= 4;                                                                                    153          hex <<= 4;                                                                                
 154         chr = *buffer++;                                                                              154          chr = *buffer++;                                                                          
 155         if ('0' <= chr && chr <= '9')                                                                 155          if ('0' <= chr && chr <= '9')                                                             
 156             hex += chr - '0';                                                                         156              hex += chr - '0';                                                                     
 157         else if ('A' <= chr && chr <= 'F')                                                            157          else if ('A' <= chr && chr <= 'F')                                                        
 158             hex += chr - 'A' + 10;                                                                    158              hex += chr - 'A' + 10;                                                                
 159         else if ('a' <= chr && chr <= 'f')                                                            159          else if ('a' <= chr && chr <= 'f')                                                        
 160             hex += chr - 'a' + 10;                                                                    160              hex += chr - 'a' + 10;                                                                
 161         else                                                                                          161          else                                                                                      
 162             return -1;                                                                                162              return -1;                                                                            
 163     }                                                                                                 163      }                                                                                             
 164     // 0x00XX ==> 0xXX00                                                                              164      // 0x00XX ==> 0xXX00                                                                          
 165     hex <<= ((4 - digits) * 4);                                                                       165      hex <<= ((4 - digits) * 4);                                                                   
 166     return hex;                                                                                       166      return hex;                                                                                   
 167 #endif                                                                                                167  #endif                                                                                            
 168 }                                                                                                     168  }

   3 #define MIN__(aa, bb)               ((aa) < (bb) ? (aa) : (bb))                                         3  #define MIN__(aa, bb)               ((aa) < (bb) ? (aa) : (bb))                                   
   4 #define MAX__(aa, bb)               ((aa) > (bb) ? (aa) : (bb))                                         4  #define MAX__(aa, bb)               ((aa) > (bb) ? (aa) : (bb))                                   
   5 #define MIN_MAX_(min, val, max)     ((val) < (min) ? (min) : ((max) < (val) ? (max) : (val)))           5  #define MIN_MAX_(min, val, max)     ((val) < (min) ? (min) : ((max) < (val) ? (max) : (val)))     
   6                                                                                                         6                                                                                                    
   7 int int_min(int aa, int bb)                                                                             7  int int_min(int aa, int bb)                                                                       
   8 {                                                                                                       8  {                                                                                                 
   9     return MIN__(aa, bb);                                                                               9      return MIN__(aa, bb);                                                                         
  10 }                                                                                                      10  }                                                                                                 
  11 int int_max(int aa, int bb)                                                                            11  int int_max(int aa, int bb)                                                                       
  12 {                                                                                                      12  {                                                                                                 
  13     return MAX__(aa, bb);                                                                              13      return MAX__(aa, bb);                                                                         
  14 }                                                                                                      14  }                                                                                                 
  15 int int_min_max(int min, int val, int max)                                                             15  int int_min_max(int min, int val, int max)                                                        
  16 {                                                                                                      16  {                                                                                                 
  17     return MIN_MAX_(min, val, max);                                                                    17      return MIN_MAX_(min, val, max);                                                               
  18 }                                                                                                      18  }

   7 #ifndef MAX                                                                                             7  #ifndef MAX                                                                                       
   8 #define MAX(aa, bb)     (aa >= bb ? aa : bb)                                                            8  #define MAX(aa, bb)     (aa >= bb ? aa : bb)
