  11 int my_select_msec(int fd_read1, int fd_read2, int fd_write1, int fd_write2,                           11  int my_select_msec(int fd_read1, int fd_read2, int fd_write1, int fd_write2,                      
  12  int fd_status1, int fd_status2, int msec)                                                             12   int fd_status1, int fd_status2, int msec)                                                        
  13 {                                                                                                      13  {                                                                                                 
  14     return my_select(fd_read1, fd_read2, fd_write1, fd_write2, fd_status1, fd_status2, msec * 1000     14      return my_select(fd_read1, fd_read2, fd_write1, fd_write2, fd_status1, fd_status2, msec * 1000
  15 }                                                                                                      15  }                                                                                                 
  16 int my_select(int fd_read1, int fd_read2, int fd_write1, int fd_write2,                                16  int my_select(int fd_read1, int fd_read2, int fd_write1, int fd_write2,                           
  17  int fd_status1, int fd_status2, int usec)                                                             17   int fd_status1, int fd_status2, int usec)                                                        
  18 {                                                                                                      18  {                                                                                                 
  19     fd_set fds_read;                                                                                   19      fd_set fds_read;                                                                              
  20     fd_set fds_write;                                                                                  20      fd_set fds_write;                                                                             
  21     fd_set fds_status;                                                                                 21      fd_set fds_status;                                                                            
  22     fd_set *fds_r = NULL;                                                                              22      fd_set *fds_r = NULL;                                                                         
  23     fd_set *fds_w = NULL;                                                                              23      fd_set *fds_w = NULL;                                                                         
  24     fd_set *fds_s = NULL;                                                                              24      fd_set *fds_s = NULL;                                                                         
  25     int max_fd = 0;                                                                                    25      int max_fd = 0;                                                                               
  26     struct timeval tv;                                                                                 26      struct timeval tv;                                                                            
  27     int ret;                                                                                           27      int ret;                                                                                      
  28                                                                                                        28                                                                                                    
  29     if (fd_read1 >= 0 || fd_read2 >= 0) {                                                              29      if (fd_read1 >= 0 || fd_read2 >= 0) {                                                         
  30         fds_r = &fds_read;                                                                             30          fds_r = &fds_read;                                                                        
  31         FD_ZERO(&fds_read);                                                                            31          FD_ZERO(&fds_read);                                                                       
  32         if (fd_read1 >= 0) {                                                                           32          if (fd_read1 >= 0) {                                                                      
  33             FD_SET(fd_read1, &fds_read);                                                               33              FD_SET(fd_read1, &fds_read);                                                          
  34             max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_read1);                                                            34              max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_read1);                                                       
  35         }                                                                                              35          }                                                                                         
  36         if (fd_read2 >= 0) {                                                                           36          if (fd_read2 >= 0) {                                                                      
  37             FD_SET(fd_read2, &fds_read);                                                               37              FD_SET(fd_read2, &fds_read);                                                          
  38             max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_read2);                                                            38              max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_read2);                                                       
  39         }                                                                                              39          }                                                                                         
  40     }                                                                                                  40      }                                                                                             
  41     if (fd_write1 >= 0 || fd_write2 >= 0) {                                                            41      if (fd_write1 >= 0 || fd_write2 >= 0) {                                                       
  42         fds_w = &fds_write;                                                                            42          fds_w = &fds_write;                                                                       
  43         FD_ZERO(&fds_write);                                                                           43          FD_ZERO(&fds_write);                                                                      
  44         if (fd_write1 >= 0) {                                                                          44          if (fd_write1 >= 0) {                                                                     
  45             FD_SET(fd_write1, &fds_write);                                                             45              FD_SET(fd_write1, &fds_write);                                                        
  46             max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_write1);                                                           46              max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_write1);                                                      
  47         }                                                                                              47          }                                                                                         
  48         if (fd_write2 >= 0) {                                                                          48          if (fd_write2 >= 0) {                                                                     
  49             FD_SET(fd_write2, &fds_write);                                                             49              FD_SET(fd_write2, &fds_write);                                                        
  50             max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_write2);                                                           50              max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_write2);                                                      
  51         }                                                                                              51          }                                                                                         
  52     }                                                                                                  52      }                                                                                             
  53     if (fd_status1 >= 0 || fd_status2 >= 0) {                                                          53      if (fd_status1 >= 0 || fd_status2 >= 0) {                                                     
  54         fds_s = &fds_status;                                                                           54          fds_s = &fds_status;                                                                      
  55         FD_ZERO(&fds_status);                                                                          55          FD_ZERO(&fds_status);                                                                     
  56         if (fd_status1 >= 0) {                                                                         56          if (fd_status1 >= 0) {                                                                    
  57             FD_SET(fd_status1, &fds_status);                                                           57              FD_SET(fd_status1, &fds_status);                                                      
  58             max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_status1);                                                          58              max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_status1);                                                     
  59         }                                                                                              59          }                                                                                         
  60         if (fd_status2 >= 0) {                                                                         60          if (fd_status2 >= 0) {                                                                    
  61             FD_SET(fd_status2, &fds_status);                                                           61              FD_SET(fd_status2, &fds_status);                                                      
  62             max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_status2);                                                          62              max_fd = MAX(max_fd, fd_status2);                                                     
  63         }                                                                                              63          }                                                                                         
  64     }                                                                                                  64      }                                                                                             
  65     tv.tv_sec = usec / 1000000;                                                                        65      tv.tv_sec = usec / 1000000;                                                                   
  66     tv.tv_usec = usec % 1000000;                                                                       66      tv.tv_usec = usec % 1000000;                                                                  
  67                                                                                                        67                                                                                                    
  68     ret = select(max_fd+1, fds_r, fds_w, fds_s, &tv);                                                  68      ret = select(max_fd+1, fds_r, fds_w, fds_s, &tv);                                             
  69                                                                                                        69                                                                                                    
  70     if (ret < 0 && errno != EINTR) {                                                                   70      if (ret < 0 && errno != EINTR) {                                                              
  71         return ret;                                                                                    71          return ret;                                                                               
  72     }                                                                                                  72      }                                                                                             
  73     if (ret == 0 || (ret < 0 && errno == EINTR)) {                                                     73      if (ret == 0 || (ret < 0 && errno == EINTR)) {                                                
  74         return MYSELECT_BIT_TIMEOUT;                                                                   74          return MYSELECT_BIT_TIMEOUT;                                                              
  75     }                                                                                                  75      }                                                                                             
  76     ret = MYSELECT_BIT_TIMEOUT;                                                                        76      ret = MYSELECT_BIT_TIMEOUT;                                                                   
  77     if (fd_read1 >= 0) {                                                                               77      if (fd_read1 >= 0) {                                                                          
  78         if (FD_ISSET(fd_read1, &fds_read)) {                                                           78          if (FD_ISSET(fd_read1, &fds_read)) {                                                      
  79             ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_READ1;                                                                 79              ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_READ1;                                                            
  80         }                                                                                              80          }                                                                                         
  81     }                                                                                                  81      }                                                                                             
  82     if (fd_read2 >= 0) {                                                                               82      if (fd_read2 >= 0) {                                                                          
  83         if (FD_ISSET(fd_read2, &fds_read)) {                                                           83          if (FD_ISSET(fd_read2, &fds_read)) {                                                      
  84             ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_READ2;                                                                 84              ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_READ2;                                                            
  85         }                                                                                              85          }                                                                                         
  86     }                                                                                                  86      }                                                                                             
  87     if (fd_write1 >= 0) {                                                                              87      if (fd_write1 >= 0) {                                                                         
  88         if (FD_ISSET(fd_write1, &fds_write)) {                                                         88          if (FD_ISSET(fd_write1, &fds_write)) {                                                    
  89             ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_WRITE1;                                                                89              ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_WRITE1;                                                           
  90         }                                                                                              90          }                                                                                         
  91     }                                                                                                  91      }                                                                                             
  92     if (fd_write2 >= 0) {                                                                              92      if (fd_write2 >= 0) {                                                                         
  93         if (FD_ISSET(fd_write2, &fds_write)) {                                                         93          if (FD_ISSET(fd_write2, &fds_write)) {                                                    
  94             ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_WRITE2;                                                                94              ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_WRITE2;                                                           
  95         }                                                                                              95          }                                                                                         
  96     }                                                                                                  96      }                                                                                             
  97     if (fd_status1 >= 0) {                                                                             97      if (fd_status1 >= 0) {                                                                        
  98         if (FD_ISSET(fd_status1, &fds_status)) {                                                       98          if (FD_ISSET(fd_status1, &fds_status)) {                                                  
  99             ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_STATUS1;                                                               99              ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_STATUS1;                                                          
 100         }                                                                                             100          }                                                                                         
 101     }                                                                                                 101      }                                                                                             
 102     if (fd_status2 >= 0) {                                                                            102      if (fd_status2 >= 0) {                                                                        
 103         if (FD_ISSET(fd_status2, &fds_status)) {                                                      103          if (FD_ISSET(fd_status2, &fds_status)) {                                                  
 104             ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_STATUS2;                                                              104              ret |= MYSELECT_BIT_STATUS2;                                                          
 105         }                                                                                             105          }                                                                                         
 106     }                                                                                                 106      }                                                                                             
 107     return ret;                                                                                       107      return ret;                                                                                   
 108 }                                                                                                     108  }

 149 c_idx_t pen_get_fgc_idx(pen_t *pen)                                                                   149  c_idx_t pen_get_fgc_idx(pen_t *pen)

 239 PRIVATE const u_short *font_get_undefined_glyph_bitmap__(                                             239  PRIVATE const u_short *font_get_undefined_glyph_bitmap__(                                         
 240  font_t *font, wchar_t ucs21, u_short *pico_font, u_short *gly,                                       240   font_t *font, wchar_t ucs21, u_short *pico_font, u_short *gly,                                   
 241  int top_space, int dots_per_digit, int digit_space)                                                  241   int top_space, int dots_per_digit, int digit_space)                                              
 242 {                                                                                                     242  {                                                                                                 
 243     u_short *gp = gly;                                                                                243      u_short *gp = gly;                                                                            
 244     if (top_space) {                                                                                  244      if (top_space) {                                                                              
 245         *gp++ = 0x0000;                                                                               245          *gp++ = 0x0000;                                                                           
 246     }                                                                                                 246      }                                                                                             
 247     for (int shift = 12; shift >= 0; shift -= 4) {  // 12, 8, 4, 0                                    247      for (int shift = 12; shift >= 0; shift -= 4) {  // 12, 8, 4, 0                                
 248         int hex = (ucs21 >> shift) & 0xf;           // 0xf000, 0x0f00, 0x00f0, 0x000f                 248          int hex = (ucs21 >> shift) & 0xf;           // 0xf000, 0x0f00, 0x00f0, 0x000f             
 249         for (int off = 0; off < dots_per_digit; off++) {                                              249          for (int off = 0; off < dots_per_digit; off++) {                                          
 250             *gp++ = pico_font[hex * dots_per_digit + off];                                            250              *gp++ = pico_font[hex * dots_per_digit + off];                                        
 251         }                                                                                             251          }                                                                                         
 252         if (shift > 0 && digit_space) {                                                               252          if (shift > 0 && digit_space) {                                                           
 253             *gp++ = 0x0000;                                                                           253              *gp++ = 0x0000;                                                                       
 254         }                                                                                             254          }                                                                                         
 255     }                                                                                                 255      }                                                                                             
 256     for ( ; gp - gly < PICOFONT_HEIGHT; ) {                                                           256      for ( ; gp - gly < PICOFONT_HEIGHT; ) {                                                       
 257         *gp++ = 0x0000;                                                                               257          *gp++ = 0x0000;                                                                           
 258     }                                                                                                 258      }                                                                                             
 259     return gly;                                                                                       259      return gly;                                                                                   
 260 }                                                                                                     260  }

 271 #endif                                                                                                271  #endif

 110                 +=======================+                           +------------------+              110                  +=======================+                           +------------------+          
 111                 |       ucon            |       +-----------+       |    console based |              111                  |       ucon            |       +-----------+       |    console based |

 114                 |                       |       | interface |       |                  |              114                  |                       |       | interface |       |                  |          
 115                 |                       |<------|           |<--+---|fd:1              |              115                  |                       |<------|           |<--+---|fd:1              |          
 116                 |                       |       +-----------+   +---|fd:2              |              116                  |                       |       +-----------+   +---|fd:2              |          
 117                 +=======================+                           +------------------+              117                  +=======================+                           +------------------+          
 118                         |||||                                                                         118                          |||||                                                                     
 119                         vvvvv render characters onto Framebuffer                                      119                          vvvvv render characters onto Framebuffer                                  
 120                     +-----------+                                                                     120                      +-----------+                                                                 
 121                     |           |                                                                     121                      |           |

 128 int term_start_child_and_serve(term_t *term)                                                          128  int term_start_child_and_serve(term_t *term)                                                      
 129 {                                                                                                     129  {                                                                                                 
 130     int err = 0;                                                                                      130      int err = 0;                                                                                  
 131                                                                                                       131                                                                                                    
 132     if ((err = term_init(term)) < 0) {                                                                132      if ((err = term_init(term)) < 0) {                                                            
 133         _ERR_                                                                                         133          _ERR_                                                                                     
 134         goto term_start_child_and_serve_err;                                                          134          goto term_start_child_and_serve_err;                                                      
 135     }                                                                                                 135      }                                                                                             
 136     fflush(stdout);                                                                                   136      fflush(stdout);                                                                               
 137     fflush(stderr);                                                                                   137      fflush(stderr);                                                                               
 138     signal_init();                                                                                    138      signal_init();                                                                                
 139                                                                                                       139                                                                                                    
 140 flf_d_printf("starting child process...\n");                                                          140  flf_d_printf("starting child process...\n");                                                      
 141     if ((child_pid = fork()) < 0) {                                                                   141      if ((child_pid = fork()) < 0) {                                                               
 142         /* error */                                                                                   142          /* error */                                                                               
 143         _ERR_                                                                                         143          _ERR_                                                                                     
 144         se_printf("fork");                                                                            144          se_printf("fork");                                                                        
 145         err = -9;                                                                                     145          err = -9;

 546 // TODO: automatically select font that can display                                                   546  // TODO: automatically select font that can display                                               
 547 //  the nearest screen character columns to before changing rotation                                  547  //  the nearest screen character columns to before changing rotation                              
 548 PRIVATE void term_select_font_by_columns(int columns)                                                 548  PRIVATE void term_select_font_by_columns(int columns)                                             
 549 {                                                                                                     549  {                                                                                                 
 550     if (fbr_chars_hx < columns) {                                                                     550      if (fbr_chars_hx < columns) {                                                                 
 551         // columns became smaller.                                                                    551          // columns became smaller.                                                                
 552         //  select smaller(mul_x == mul_y) font and make columns larger                               552          //  select smaller(mul_x == mul_y) font and make columns larger                           
 553         int shift = -1;                                                                               553          int shift = -1;                                                                           
 554         while (fbr_chars_hx < columns || (cur_font_mul->mul_x != cur_font_mul->mul_y)) {              554          while (fbr_chars_hx < columns || (cur_font_mul->mul_x != cur_font_mul->mul_y)) {          
 555             int prev_cur_font_mul_idx = cur_font_mul_idx;                                             555              int prev_cur_font_mul_idx = cur_font_mul_idx;                                         
 556             cur_font_mul_idx = font_select_next(cur_font_mul_idx, shift);                             556              cur_font_mul_idx = font_select_next(cur_font_mul_idx, shift);                         
 557             if (cur_font_mul_idx == prev_cur_font_mul_idx) {                                          557              if (cur_font_mul_idx == prev_cur_font_mul_idx) {                                      
 558                 break;                                                                                558                  break;                                                                            
 559             }                                                                                         559              }                                                                                     
 560             term_setup_font_and_rotation_parameters(1);                                               560              term_setup_font_and_rotation_parameters(1);                                           
 561         }                                                                                             561          }                                                                                         
 562     } else {                                                                                          562      } else {                                                                                      
 563         // columns became bigger.                                                                     563          // columns became bigger.                                                                 
 564         //  select larger(mul_x == mul_y) font and make columns smaller                               564          //  select larger(mul_x == mul_y) font and make columns smaller                           
 565         int shift = +1;                                                                               565          int shift = +1;                                                                           
 566         while (fbr_chars_hx > columns || (cur_font_mul->mul_x != cur_font_mul->mul_y)) {              566          while (fbr_chars_hx > columns || (cur_font_mul->mul_x != cur_font_mul->mul_y)) {          
 567             int prev_cur_font_mul_idx = cur_font_mul_idx;                                             567              int prev_cur_font_mul_idx = cur_font_mul_idx;                                         
 568             cur_font_mul_idx = font_select_next(cur_font_mul_idx, shift);                             568              cur_font_mul_idx = font_select_next(cur_font_mul_idx, shift);                         
 569             if (cur_font_mul_idx == prev_cur_font_mul_idx) {                                          569              if (cur_font_mul_idx == prev_cur_font_mul_idx) {                                      
 570                 break;                                                                                570                  break;                                                                            
 571             }                                                                                         571              }                                                                                     
 572             term_setup_font_and_rotation_parameters(1);                                               572              term_setup_font_and_rotation_parameters(1);                                           
 573         }                                                                                             573          }                                                                                         
 574     }                                                                                                 574      }                                                                                             
 575 }                                                                                                     575  }

  62     runner_uid = getuid();                                                                             62      runner_uid = getuid();                                                                        
  63     owner_uid = geteuid();  /* if setuid, owner_uid is root */                                         63      owner_uid = geteuid();  /* if setuid, owner_uid is root */                                    
  64 ///flf_d_printf("real:%d effective:%d\n", runner_uid, owner_uid);                                      64  ///flf_d_printf("real:%d effective:%d\n", runner_uid, owner_uid);                                 
  65     /* swap real and effective */                                                                      65      /* swap real and effective */                                                                 
  66     util_privilege_lower();                                                                            66      util_privilege_lower();                                                                       
  67 }                                                                                                      67  }                                                                                                 
  68                                                                                                        68                                                                                                    
  69 uid_t util_getuid()                                                                                    69  uid_t util_getuid()                                                                               
  70 {                                                                                                      70  {                                                                                                 
  71     return runner_uid;                                                                                 71      return runner_uid;                                                                            
  72 }                                                                                                      72  }                                                                                                 
  73                                                                                                        73                                                                                                    
  74 void util_privilege_raise()                                                                            74  void util_privilege_raise()                                                                       
  75 {                                                                                                      75  {                                                                                                 
  76     if (setreuid(runner_uid, owner_uid) < 0) {                                                         76      if (setreuid(runner_uid, owner_uid) < 0) {                                                    
  77         perror("setreuid()");                                                                          77          perror("setreuid()");                                                                     
  78     }                                                                                                  78      }                                                                                             
  79 }                                                                                                      79  }                                                                                                 
  80                                                                                                        80                                                                                                    
  81 void util_privilege_lower()                                                                            81  void util_privilege_lower()                                                                       
  82 {                                                                                                      82  {

  84         perror("setreuid()");                                                                          84          perror("setreuid()");                                                                     
  85     }                                                                                                  85      }                                                                                             
  86 }                                                                                                      86  }

  91         perror("setreuid()");                                                                          91          perror("setreuid()");

 159     }                                                                                                 159      }                                                                                             
 160 ///dump_string(string, bytes);                                                                        160  ///dump_string(string, bytes);                                                                    
 161 #ifdef ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                                   161  #ifdef ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                               
 162 ///                                                                                                   162  ///                                                                                               
 163 mflf_d_printf("%d:\n %s\n", bytes, dump_string_to_static_buf(string, bytes));                         163  mflf_d_printf("%d:\n %s\n", bytes, dump_string_to_static_buf(string, bytes));                     
 164 #endif // ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                                164  #endif // ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                            
 165     while (bytes-- > 0) {                                                                             165      while (bytes-- > 0) {                                                                         
 166         u_char chr = *(string++);                                                                     166          u_char chr = *(string++);                                                                 
 167 #ifdef ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                                   167  #ifdef ENABLE_DEBUG

 169 mflf_d_printf("(%d, %d)%02x[%c]\n", vterm_pen_get_y(vterm), vterm_pen_get_x(vterm), chr, isgraph(c    169  mflf_d_printf("(%d, %d)%02x[%c]\n", vterm_pen_get_y(vterm), vterm_pen_get_x(vterm), chr, isgraph(c
 170 #endif // ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                                170  #endif // ENABLE_DEBUG

 174                                                                                                       174                                                                                                    
 175 int vterm_emulate_char(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                                    175  int vterm_emulate_char(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                                
 176 {                                                                                                     176  {                                                                                                 
 177     put_parsed_str(chr);                                                                              177      put_parsed_str(chr);                                                                          
 178     if (vterm->esc_seq_parse_state > ESC_ST_0) {                                                      178      if (vterm->esc_seq_parse_state > ESC_ST_0) {                                                  
 179         vterm_reset_utf8_state(vterm);                                                                179          vterm_reset_utf8_state(vterm);                                                            
 180     }                                                                                                 180      }                                                                                             
 181     switch(vterm->esc_seq_parse_state) {                                                              181      switch(vterm->esc_seq_parse_state) {                                                          
 182     case ESC_ST_0:                                                                                    182      case ESC_ST_0:                                                                                
 183         if (vterm_iso_C0_set(vterm, chr)) {                                                           183          if (vterm_iso_C0_set(vterm, chr)) {                                                       
 184             vterm_reset_utf8_state(vterm);                                                            184              vterm_reset_utf8_state(vterm);                                                        
 185         } else {                                                                                      185          } else {                                                                                  
 186             if (vterm_parse_utf8_seq(vterm, chr) == 0) {                                              186              if (vterm_parse_utf8_seq(vterm, chr) == 0) {                                          
 187                 vterm_put_ucs32_char(vterm, vterm->ucs32);                                            187                  vterm_put_ucs32_char(vterm, vterm->ucs32);                                        
 188             }                                                                                         188              }                                                                                     
 189         }                                                                                             189          }                                                                                         
 190         break;                                                                                        190          break;                                                                                    
 191     case ESC_ST_1_ESC:  // ESC                                                                        191      case ESC_ST_1_ESC:  // ESC                                                                    
 192         vterm_parse_func_esc(vterm, chr);                                                             192          vterm_parse_func_esc(vterm, chr);                                                         
 193         break;                                                                                        193          break;                                                                                    
 194     case ESC_ST_2_CSI:  // ESC [                                                                      194      case ESC_ST_2_CSI:  // ESC [

 210         }                                                                                             210          }                                                                                         
 211         vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                        211          vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                    
 212         break;                                                                                        212          break;                                                                                    
 213 #ifdef ENABLE_STATUS_LINE                                                                             213  #ifdef ENABLE_STATUS_LINE                                                                         
 214     case ESC_ST_5_SL:                                                                                 214      case ESC_ST_5_SL:                                                                             
 215         vterm_parse_func_status_line(vterm, chr);                                                     215          vterm_parse_func_status_line(vterm, chr);                                                 
 216         break;                                                                                        216          break;                                                                                    
 217 #endif // ENABLE_STATUS_LINE                                                                          217  #endif // ENABLE_STATUS_LINE                                                                      
 218     }                                                                                                 218      }                                                                                             
 219     if (vterm->scroll > 0) {                                                                          219      if (vterm->scroll > 0) {                                                                      
 220         vterm_text_scroll_up(vterm, vterm->scroll);                                                   220          vterm_text_scroll_up(vterm, vterm->scroll);                                               
 221     } else if (vterm->scroll < 0) {                                                                   221      } else if (vterm->scroll < 0) {                                                               
 222         vterm_text_scroll_down(vterm, -(vterm->scroll));                                              222          vterm_text_scroll_down(vterm, -(vterm->scroll));                                          
 223     }                                                                                                 223      }                                                                                             
 224     vterm->scroll = 0;                                                                                224      vterm->scroll = 0;                                                                            
 225     return 0;                                                                                         225      return 0;                                                                                     
 226 }                                                                                                     226  }

 289 {                                                                                                     289  {                                                                                                 
 290     if (chr < 0x80) {                   // 0x00--0x7f                                                 290      if (chr < 0x80) {                   // 0x00--0x7f

 295         }                                                                                             295          }                                                                                         
 296         vterm->ucs32 = chr;                                                                           296          vterm->ucs32 = chr;                                                                       
 297         // ASCII char, send ucs32                                                                     297          // ASCII char, send ucs32                                                                 
 298     } else if ((chr & 0xc0) == 0x80) {  // 10xxxxxx                                                   298      } else if ((chr & 0xc0) == 0x80) {  // 10xxxxxx

 305             vterm->utf8_state--;                                                                      305              vterm->utf8_state--;                                                                  
 306             // end of UTF-8 sequence, send ucs32                                                      306              // end of UTF-8 sequence, send ucs32                                                  
 307         }                                                                                             307          }                                                                                         
 308     } else if ((chr & 0xc0) == 0xc0) {  // 11xxxxxx                                                   308      } else if ((chr & 0xc0) == 0xc0) {  // 11xxxxxx                                               
 309         if (vterm->utf8_state) {                                                                      309          if (vterm->utf8_state) {

 311             dump_parsed_str();                                                                        311              dump_parsed_str();                                                                    
 312         }                                                                                             312          }                                                                                         
 313         if ((chr & 0xe0) == 0xc0) { // 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx                                              313          if ((chr & 0xe0) == 0xc0) { // 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx                                          
 314             vterm->utf8_state = 1;                                                                    314              vterm->utf8_state = 1;                                                                
 315             vterm->ucs32 = (chr & 0x1f);                                                              315              vterm->ucs32 = (chr & 0x1f);                                                          
 316         } else if ((chr & 0xf0) == 0xe0) {  // 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx                             316          } else if ((chr & 0xf0) == 0xe0) {  // 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx                         
 317             vterm->utf8_state = 2;                                                                    317              vterm->utf8_state = 2;                                                                
 318             vterm->ucs32 = (chr & 0x0f);                                                              318              vterm->ucs32 = (chr & 0x0f);                                                          
 319         } else if ((chr & 0xf8) == 0xf0) {  // 11110xxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx                    319          } else if ((chr & 0xf8) == 0xf0) {  // 11110xxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx                
 320             vterm->utf8_state = 3;                                                                    320              vterm->utf8_state = 3;                                                                
 321             vterm->ucs32 = (chr & 0x07);                                                              321              vterm->ucs32 = (chr & 0x07);                                                          
 322         } else if ((chr & 0xfc) == 0xf8) {  // 111110xx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx           322          } else if ((chr & 0xfc) == 0xf8) {  // 111110xx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx

 325         } else if ((chr & 0xfe) == 0xfc) {  // 1111110x 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxx    325          } else if ((chr & 0xfe) == 0xfc) {  // 1111110x 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxx
 326             vterm->utf8_state = 5;                                                                    326              vterm->utf8_state = 5;

 431 PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_esc(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                         431  PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_esc(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                     
 432 {                                                                                                     432  {                                                                                                 
 433     vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                            433      vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;

 447             vterm_pen_move_yx(vterm, +1, 0);                                                          447              vterm_pen_move_yx(vterm, +1, 0);                                                      
 448         }                                                                                             448          }                                                                                         
 449         break;                                                                                        449          break;                                                                                    
 450     case 'E'/*Fe(ISO_NEL)*/:    /* ESC E */                                                           450      case 'E'/*Fe(ISO_NEL)*/:    /* ESC E */                                                       
 451         vterm_pen_set_x(vterm, 0);                                                                    451          vterm_pen_set_x(vterm, 0);                                                                
 452         /* fall into next case */                                                                     452          /* fall into next case */                                                                 
 453     case 'M'/*Fe(ISO_RI)*/:     /* ESC M */                                                           453      case 'M'/*Fe(ISO_RI)*/:     /* ESC M */                                                       
 454         if (vterm_pen_get_y(vterm) <= vterm->top_y) {                                                 454          if (vterm_pen_get_y(vterm) <= vterm->top_y) {                                             
 455             vterm->scroll--;                                                                          455              vterm->scroll--;                                                                      
 456         } else {                                                                                      456          } else {                                                                                  
 457             vterm_pen_move_yx(vterm, -1, 0);                                                          457              vterm_pen_move_yx(vterm, -1, 0);                                                      
 458         }                                                                                             458          }                                                                                         
 459         break;                                                                                        459          break;                                                                                    
 460     case 'c'/*ISO_RIS*/:        /* ESC c (Reset to Initial State) */                                  460      case 'c'/*ISO_RIS*/:        /* ESC c (Reset to Initial State) */                              
 461         pen_init(&(vterm->pen));                                                                      461          pen_init(&(vterm->pen));                                                                  
 462         vterm_init_scroll_region(vterm);                                                              462          vterm_init_scroll_region(vterm);                                                          
 463         vterm_text_clear_all(vterm);                                                                  463          vterm_text_clear_all(vterm);                                                              
 464         vterm_repaint_all(vterm);                                                                     464          vterm_repaint_all(vterm);                                                                 
 465         break;                                                                                        465          break;                                                                                    
 466     case '7'/*DEC_SC*/:         /* ESC 7 */                                                           466      case '7'/*DEC_SC*/:         /* ESC 7 */                                                       
 467         vterm_push_pen(vterm, TRUE);                                                                  467          vterm_push_pen(vterm, TRUE);                                                              
 468         break;                                                                                        468          break;                                                                                    
 469     case '8'/*DEC_RC*/:         /* ESC 8 */                                                           469      case '8'/*DEC_RC*/:         /* ESC 8 */                                                       
 470         vterm_pop_pen(vterm, TRUE);                                                                   470          vterm_pop_pen(vterm, TRUE);                                                               
 471         break;                                                                                        471          break;                                                                                    
 472                                                                                                       472                                                                                                    
 473     case '$'/*ISO__MBS*/:       /* $ */                                                               473      case '$'/*ISO__MBS*/:       /* $ */                                                           
 474         break;                                                                                        474          break;                                                                                    
 475     case '%'/*ISO_DOCS*/:       /* % */                                                               475      case '%'/*ISO_DOCS*/:       /* % */                                                           
 476         break;                                                                                        476          break;                                                                                    
 477     case '('/*ISO_GZD4*/:       /* ESC ( */                                                           477      case '('/*ISO_GZD4*/:       /* ESC ( */                                                       
 478         vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_4_LPAR;                                                   478          vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_4_LPAR;                                               
 479         break;                                                                                        479          break;                                                                                    
 480     case ','/*MULE__GZD6*/:     /* , */                                                               480      case ','/*MULE__GZD6*/:     /* , */                                                           
 481         break;                                                                                        481          break;                                                                                    
 482     case ')'/*ISO_G1D4*/:       /* ) */                                                               482      case ')'/*ISO_G1D4*/:       /* ) */                                                           
 483         break;                                                                                        483          break;                                                                                    
 484     case '-'/*ISO_G1D6*/:       /* - */                                                               484      case '-'/*ISO_G1D6*/:       /* - */                                                           
 485         break;                                                                                        485          break;                                                                                    
 486     case '*'/*ISO_G2D4*/:       /* * */                                                               486      case '*'/*ISO_G2D4*/:       /* * */                                                           
 487         break;                                                                                        487          break;                                                                                    
 488     case '.'/*ISO_G2D6*/:       /* . */                                                               488      case '.'/*ISO_G2D6*/:       /* . */                                                           
 489         break;                                                                                        489          break;                                                                                    
 490     case '+'/*ISO_G3D4*/:       /* + */                                                               490      case '+'/*ISO_G3D4*/:       /* + */                                                           
 491         break;                                                                                        491          break;                                                                                    
 492     case '/'/*ISO_G3D6*/:       /* / */                                                               492      case '/'/*ISO_G3D6*/:       /* / */                                                           
 493         break;                                                                                        493          break;                                                                                    
 494     case 'H':                   /* ESC H */                                                           494      case 'H':                   /* ESC H */                                                       
 495         // set horizontal tab position                                                                495          // set horizontal tab position                                                            
 496         break;                                                                                        496          break;                                                                                    
 497     case 'N'/*Fe(ISO_SS2)*/:    /* N *//* 7bit single shift 2 */                                      497      case 'N'/*Fe(ISO_SS2)*/:    /* N *//* 7bit single shift 2 */                                  
 498         break;                                                                                        498          break;                                                                                    
 499     case 'O'/*Fe(ISO_SS3)*/:    /* O *//* 7bit single shift 3 */                                      499      case 'O'/*Fe(ISO_SS3)*/:    /* O *//* 7bit single shift 3 */                                  
 500         break;                                                                                        500          break;                                                                                    
 501     case 'n'/*ISO_LS2*/:        /* n */                                                               501      case 'n'/*ISO_LS2*/:        /* n */                                                           
 502         break;                                                                                        502          break;                                                                                    
 503     case 'o'/*ISO_LS3*/:        /* o */                                                               503      case 'o'/*ISO_LS3*/:        /* o */                                                           
 504         break;                                                                                        504          break;                                                                                    
 505     case '|'/*ISO_LS3R*/:       /* | */                                                               505      case '|'/*ISO_LS3R*/:       /* | */                                                           
 506         break;                                                                                        506          break;                                                                                    
 507     case '}'/*ISO_LS2R*/:       /* } */                                                               507      case '}'/*ISO_LS2R*/:       /* } */                                                           
 508         break;                                                                                        508          break;                                                                                    
 509     case '~'/*ISO_LS1R*/:       /* ~ */                                                               509      case '~'/*ISO_LS1R*/:       /* ~ */                                                           
 510         break;                                                                                        510          break;                                                                                    
 511     default:                                                                                          511      default:                                                                                      
 512         flf_d_printf("illegal ESC sequence: ESC %c\n", chr);                                          512          flf_d_printf("illegal ESC sequence: ESC %c\n", chr);                                      
 513         dump_parsed_str();                                                                            513          dump_parsed_str();                                                                        
 514         break;                                                                                        514          break;                                                                                    
 515     }                                                                                                 515      }                                                                                             
 516 }                                                                                                     516  }

 518 // parse ESC '[' ...                                                                                  518  // parse ESC '[' ...                                                                              
 519 PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_csi(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                         519  PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_csi(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                     
 520 {                                                                                                     520  {                                                                                                 
 521     int arg_idx;                                                                                      521      int arg_idx;                                                                                  
 522                                                                                                       522

 531     case 'A'/*ISO_CS_NO_CUU*/:  // ESC [ {n} A                                                        531      case 'A'/*ISO_CS_NO_CUU*/:  // ESC [ {n} A

 554     case 'P':           // ESC [ {n} P                                                                554      case 'P':           // ESC [ {n} P                                                            
 555         vterm_delete_n_columns(vterm, DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                      555          vterm_delete_n_columns(vterm, DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));

 557     case '@':           // ESC [ {n} @                                                                557      case '@':           // ESC [ {n} @

 559         break;                                                                                        559          break;                                                                                    
 560     case 'H':           // ESC [ {line} ; {col} H                                                     560      case 'H':           // ESC [ {line} ; {col} H                                                 
 561     case 'f':           // ESC [ {line} ; {col} f                                                     561      case 'f':           // ESC [ {line} ; {col} f                                                 
 562         vterm_pen_set_yx(vterm, DEF_TO_0(get_csi_arg(0)), DEF_TO_0(get_csi_arg(1)));                  562          vterm_pen_set_yx(vterm, DEF_TO_0(get_csi_arg(0)), DEF_TO_0(get_csi_arg(1)));

 564     case 'd':                                                                                         564      case 'd':

 566         vterm_pen_set_y(vterm, DEF_TO_0(get_csi_arg(0)));                                             566          vterm_pen_set_y(vterm, DEF_TO_0(get_csi_arg(0)));                                         
 567         break;                                                                                        567          break;                                                                                    
 568     case 'J':           // ESC [ {n} J                                                                568      case 'J':           // ESC [ {n} J                                                            
 569         vterm_clear_in_screen_mode(vterm, get_csi_arg(0));                                            569          vterm_clear_in_screen_mode(vterm, get_csi_arg(0));                                        
 570         break;                                                                                        570          break;                                                                                    
 571     case 'K':           // ESC [ {n} K                                                                571      case 'K':           // ESC [ {n} K

 573         break;                                                                                        573          break;

 576          DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                                   576           DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));

 578     case 'M':           // ESC [ {n} M                                                                578      case 'M':           // ESC [ {n} M
