 580          DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                                   580           DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                               
 581         break;                                                                                        581          break;                                                                                    
 582     case 'S':           // ESC [ {n} S                                                                582      case 'S':           // ESC [ {n} S                                                            
 583         vterm_text_scroll_down_region(vterm, 0, vterm->bottom_y,                                      583          vterm_text_scroll_down_region(vterm, 0, vterm->bottom_y,                                  
 584          DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                                   584           DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                               
 585         break;                                                                                        585          break;                                                                                    
 586     case 'T':           // ESC [ {n} T                                                                586      case 'T':           // ESC [ {n} T

 588          DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                                   588           DEF_TO_1(get_csi_arg(0)));                                                               
 589         break;                                                                                        589          break;                                                                                    
 590     case 'X':           // ESC [ {n} X                                                                590      case 'X':           // ESC [ {n} X                                                            
 591         vterm_text_clear_columns(vterm, get_csi_arg(0));                                              591          vterm_text_clear_columns(vterm, get_csi_arg(0));                                          
 592         break;                                                                                        592          break;                                                                                    
 593     case 'g':           // ESC [ {arg1} g                                                             593      case 'g':           // ESC [ {arg1} g                                                         
 594         switch (get_csi_arg(0)) {                                                                     594          switch (get_csi_arg(0)) {                                                                 
 595         case 0: // clear horizontal tab position                                                      595          case 0: // clear horizontal tab position                                                  
 596         case 1: // clear vertical tab position                                                        596          case 1: // clear vertical tab position                                                    
 597         case 2: // clear current line vertical tab position                                           597          case 2: // clear current line vertical tab position                                       
 598         case 3: // clear current line horizontal tab position                                         598          case 3: // clear current line horizontal tab position                                     
 599         case 4: // clear vertical tab position                                                        599          case 4: // clear vertical tab position                                                    
 600         case 5: // clear horizontal and vertical tab position                                         600          case 5: // clear horizontal and vertical tab position                                     
 601             break;                                                                                    601              break;                                                                                
 602         }                                                                                             602          }                                                                                         
 603         break;                                                                                        603          break;                                                                                    
 604     case 'm':           // ESC [ {arg1} ; {arg2} ; ... ; {arg9} m                                     604      case 'm':           // ESC [ {arg1} ; {arg2} ; ... ; {arg9} m                                 
 605         for (arg_idx = 0; arg_idx <= get_csi_arg_idx(); arg_idx++) {                                  605          for (arg_idx = 0; arg_idx <= get_csi_arg_idx(); arg_idx++) {                              
 606             arg_idx = vterm_esc_set_attr(vterm, get_csi_arg(arg_idx), arg_idx);                       606              arg_idx = vterm_esc_set_attr(vterm, get_csi_arg(arg_idx), arg_idx);

 651         break;                                                                                        651          break;

 653         break;                                                                                        653          break;                                                                                    
 654     case '?':           // ESC [ {n} ?                                                                654      case '?':           // ESC [ {n} ?

 656         vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_5_SL;                                                     656          vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_5_SL;                                                 
 657 #else                                                                                                 657  #else                                                                                             
 658         vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_2_CSI;                                                    658          vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_2_CSI;                                                
 659 #endif // ENABLE_STATUS_LINE                                                                          659  #endif // ENABLE_STATUS_LINE                                                                      
 660         break;                                                                                        660          break;

 664         break;                                                                                        664          break;                                                                                    
 665     }                                                                                                 665      }                                                                                             
 666     if (vterm->esc_seq_parse_state == ESC_ST_0) {                                                     666      if (vterm->esc_seq_parse_state == ESC_ST_0) {                                                 
 667         clear_csi_args();                                                                             667          clear_csi_args();                                                                         
 668     }                                                                                                 668      }                                                                                             
 669 }                                                                                                     669  }

 671 // parse ESC ']' ...                                                                                  671  // parse ESC ']' ...                                                                              
 672 PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_osc(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                         672  PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_osc(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                     
 673 {                                                                                                     673  {                                                                                                 
 674     if (parse_csi_args(vterm, chr)) {                                                                 674      if (parse_csi_args(vterm, chr)) {                                                             
 675         return;                                                                                       675          return;                                                                                   
 676     }                                                                                                 676      }                                                                                             
 677     vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                            677      vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                        
 678 #ifdef ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                                   678  #ifdef ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                               
 679     dump_csi_args(chr);                                                                               679      dump_csi_args(chr);                                                                           
 680 #endif // ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                                680  #endif // ENABLE_DEBUG                                                                            
 681     switch(chr) {                                                                                     681      switch(chr) {                                                                                 
 682     case 'R':           // ESC ] {n} R                                                                682      case 'R':           // ESC ] {n} R                                                            
 683         // Linux reset command generate this (ESC ] R) sequence                                       683          // Linux reset command generate this (ESC ] R) sequence                                   
 684         break;                                                                                        684          break;

 698 // parse ESC [ ? ...                                                                                  698  // parse ESC [ ? ...                                                                              
 699 PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_status_line(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                 699  PRIVATE void vterm_parse_func_status_line(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                             
 700 {                                                                                                     700  {                                                                                                 
 701     vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                            701      vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_0;                                                        
 702     switch(chr) {                                                                                     702      switch(chr) {                                                                                 
 703     case 'T':   /* To */                                                                              703      case 'T':   /* To */                                                                          
 704         if (vterm->status_line == SL_ENTER)                                                           704          if (vterm->status_line == SL_ENTER)                                                       
 705             break;                                                                                    705              break;                                                                                
 706         vterm_push_pen(vterm, FALSE);                                                                 706          vterm_push_pen(vterm, FALSE);                                                             
 707         /* fall into next case */                                                                     707          /* fall into next case */                                                                 
 708     case 'S':   /* Show */                                                                            708      case 'S':   /* Show */                                                                        
 709         if (vterm->status_line == SL_NONE) {                                                          709          if (vterm->status_line == SL_NONE) {                                                      
 710             vterm->bottom_y = vterm->text_lines - 1;                                                  710              vterm->bottom_y = vterm->text_lines - 1;                                              
 711         }                                                                                             711          }                                                                                         
 712         if (chr == 'T') {                                                                             712          if (chr == 'T') {                                                                         
 713             vterm->status_line = SL_ENTER;                                                            713              vterm->status_line = SL_ENTER;                                                        
 714             vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm, vterm->text_lines - 1, vterm->text_lines);         714              vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm, vterm->text_lines - 1, vterm->text_lines);     
 715         }                                                                                             715          }                                                                                         
 716         break;                                                                                        716          break;                                                                                    
 717     case 'F':   /* From */                                                                            717      case 'F':   /* From */                                                                        
 718         if (vterm->status_line == SL_ENTER) {                                                         718          if (vterm->status_line == SL_ENTER) {                                                     
 719             vterm->status_line = SL_LEAVE;                                                            719              vterm->status_line = SL_LEAVE;                                                        
 720             vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm, 0, vterm->text_lines - 1);                         720              vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm, 0, vterm->text_lines - 1);                     
 721             vterm_pop_pen(vterm, FALSE);                                                              721              vterm_pop_pen(vterm, FALSE);                                                          
 722         }                                                                                             722          }                                                                                         
 723         break;                                                                                        723          break;                                                                                    
 724     case 'H':   /* Hide */                                                                            724      case 'H':   /* Hide */                                                                        
 725     case 'E':   /* Erase */                                                                           725      case 'E':   /* Erase */                                                                       
 726         if (vterm->status_line == SL_NONE) {                                                          726          if (vterm->status_line == SL_NONE) {                                                      
 727             break;                                                                                    727              break;                                                                                
 728         }                                                                                             728          }                                                                                         
 729         vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm, 0, vterm->text_lines);                                 729          vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm, 0, vterm->text_lines);                             
 730         vterm->status_line = SL_NONE;                                                                 730          vterm->status_line = SL_NONE;                                                             
 731         break;                                                                                        731          break;                                                                                    
 732     default:                                                                                          732      default:                                                                                      
 733         vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_2_CSI;                                                    733          vterm->esc_seq_parse_state = ESC_ST_2_CSI;                                                
 734         vterm_parse_func_csi(vterm, chr);                                                             734          vterm_parse_func_csi(vterm, chr);                                                         
 735         break;                                                                                        735          break;                                                                                    
 736     }                                                                                                 736      }                                                                                             
 737 }                                                                                                     737  }

 885 PRIVATE rgb15_t rgb15_from_color256_idx(u_char color256_idx)                                          885  PRIVATE rgb15_t rgb15_from_color256_idx(u_char color256_idx)                                      
 886 {                                                                                                     886  {                                                                                                 
 887     int color_idx;                                                                                    887      int color_idx;                                                                                
 888     int rr, gg, bb;                                                                                   888      int rr, gg, bb;                                                                               
 889                                                                                                       889                                                                                                    
 890     // 16 ANSI + 216 RGB + 24 Gray-scale = 256 colors                                                 890      // 16 ANSI + 216 RGB + 24 Gray-scale = 256 colors                                             
 891     if (color256_idx < 16) {                                                                          891      if (color256_idx < 16) {                                                                      
 892         // 16 ANSI colors                                                                             892          // 16 ANSI colors                                                                         
 893         color_idx = color256_idx;       // [0, 15]                                                    893          color_idx = color256_idx;       // [0, 15]                                                
 894         return rgb15_from_color_idx(color_idx);                                                       894          return rgb15_from_color_idx(color_idx);                                                   
 895     } else                                                                                            895      } else                                                                                        
 896     if (color256_idx < 16 + 216) {                                                                    896      if (color256_idx < 16 + 216) {                                                                
 897         // 216 RGB colors (216 = 6 * 6 * 6)                                                           897          // 216 RGB colors (216 = 6 * 6 * 6)                                                       
 898         color_idx = color256_idx - 16;  // [16, 232) ==> [0, 216)                                     898          color_idx = color256_idx - 16;  // [16, 232) ==> [0, 216)                                 
 899         bb = (color_idx % 6);       // [0, 5]                                                         899          bb = (color_idx % 6);       // [0, 5]                                                     
 900         gg = ((color_idx / 6) % 6); // [0, 5]                                                         900          gg = ((color_idx / 6) % 6); // [0, 5]                                                     
 901         rr = (color_idx / 36);      // [0, 5]                                                         901          rr = (color_idx / 36);      // [0, 5]                                                     
 902         bb *= 51;   // 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255                                                      902          bb *= 51;   // 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255                                                  
 903         gg *= 51;   // 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255                                                      903          gg *= 51;   // 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255                                                  
 904         rr *= 51;   // 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255                                                      904          rr *= 51;   // 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255                                                  
 905         return rgb15_from_r_g_b_24(rr, gg, bb);                                                       905          return rgb15_from_r_g_b_24(rr, gg, bb);                                                   
 906     } else {                                                                                          906      } else {                                                                                      
 907         // 24 gray scale colors                                                                       907          // 24 gray scale colors                                                                   
 908         color_idx = color256_idx - (16 + 216);  // [232, 255] ==> [0, 23]                             908          color_idx = color256_idx - (16 + 216);  // [232, 255] ==> [0, 23]                         
 909         color_idx *= 11;                        // [0, 253]                                           909          color_idx *= 11;                        // [0, 253]                                       
 910         return rgb15_from_r_g_b_24(color_idx, color_idx, color_idx);                                  910          return rgb15_from_r_g_b_24(color_idx, color_idx, color_idx);                              
 911     }                                                                                                 911      }                                                                                             
 912 }                                                                                                     912  }

 933 PRIVATE void vterm_pop_pen(vterm_t *vterm, bool_t bb)                                                 933  PRIVATE void vterm_pop_pen(vterm_t *vterm, bool_t bb)

 939         }                                                                                             939          }                                                                                         
 940     } else {                                                                                          940      } else {                                                                                      
 941         if (vterm->pen_sl_stack_ptr > 0) {                                                            941          if (vterm->pen_sl_stack_ptr > 0) {                                                        
 942             vterm->pen_sl_stack_ptr--;                                                                942              vterm->pen_sl_stack_ptr--;                                                            
 943             pen_copy(&vterm->pen, &vterm->pen_sl_stack[vterm->pen_sl_stack_ptr]);                     943              pen_copy(&vterm->pen, &vterm->pen_sl_stack[vterm->pen_sl_stack_ptr]);                 
 944         }                                                                                             944          }                                                                                         
 945     }                                                                                                 945      }                                                                                             
 946 }                                                                                                     946  }

 948 PRIVATE void vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm_t *vterm, int top_y, int bottom_y)                 948  PRIVATE void vterm_set_scroll_region__adjust(vterm_t *vterm, int top_y, int bottom_y)             
 949 {                                                                                                     949  {                                                                                                 
 950     if (top_y < 0 || vterm->text_lines <= top_y                                                       950      if (top_y < 0 || vterm->text_lines <= top_y                                                   
 951      || bottom_y < 0 || vterm->text_lines < bottom_y                                                  951       || bottom_y < 0 || vterm->text_lines < bottom_y                                              
 952      || top_y >= bottom_y) {                                                                          952       || top_y >= bottom_y) {                                                                      
 953         flf_d_printf("illegal (top:%d, bottom:%d)\n", top_y, bottom_y);                               953          flf_d_printf("illegal (top:%d, bottom:%d)\n", top_y, bottom_y);                           
 954         // illegal parameter                                                                          954          // illegal parameter                                                                      
 955         return;                                                                                       955          return;                                                                                   
 956     }                                                                                                 956      }                                                                                             
 957     vterm_set_scroll_region(vterm, top_y, bottom_y);                                                  957      vterm_set_scroll_region(vterm, top_y, bottom_y);                                              
 958     vterm_pen_set_x(vterm, 0);                                                                        958      vterm_pen_set_x(vterm, 0);                                                                    
 959     if (vterm_pen_get_y(vterm) < vterm->top_y) {                                                      959      if (vterm_pen_get_y(vterm) < vterm->top_y) {                                                  
 960         // pen position is out of region, correct it                                                  960          // pen position is out of region, correct it                                              
 961         vterm_pen_set_y(vterm, vterm->top_y);                                                         961          vterm_pen_set_y(vterm, vterm->top_y);                                                     
 962     } else if (vterm->bottom_y <= vterm_pen_get_y(vterm)) {                                           962      } else if (vterm->bottom_y <= vterm_pen_get_y(vterm)) {                                       
 963         // pen position is out of region, correct it                                                  963          // pen position is out of region, correct it                                              
 964         vterm_pen_set_y(vterm, vterm->bottom_y-1);                                                    964          vterm_pen_set_y(vterm, vterm->bottom_y-1);                                                
 965     }                                                                                                 965      }                                                                                             
 966 }                                                                                                     966  }

 978     }                                                                                                 978      }

 981 PRIVATE void vterm_esc_report(vterm_t *vterm, u_char mode, u_short arg)                               981  PRIVATE void vterm_esc_report(vterm_t *vterm, u_char mode, u_short arg)                           
 982 {                                                                                                     982  {                                                                                                 
 983 #define MAX_REPORT_LEN      100                                                                       983  #define MAX_REPORT_LEN      100                                                                   
 984     char report[MAX_REPORT_LEN+1];                                                                    984      char report[MAX_REPORT_LEN+1];                                                                
 985                                                                                                       985                                                                                                    
 986     report[0] = '\0';                                                                                 986      report[0] = '\0';                                                                             
 987     switch(mode) {                                                                                    987      switch(mode) {                                                                                
 988     case 'n':                                                                                         988      case 'n':                                                                                     
 989         switch(arg) {                                                                                 989          switch(arg) {                                                                             
 990         case 5:                                                                                       990          case 5:                                                                                   
 991             // send "device OK"                                                                       991              // send "device OK"                                                                   
 992             strcpy(report, "\x1B[0n\0");                                                              992              strcpy(report, "\x1B[0n\0");                                                          
 993             break;                                                                                    993              break;                                                                                
 994         case 6:                                                                                       994          case 6:                                                                                   
 995             // send "current cursor position"                                                         995              // send "current cursor position"                                                     
 996             snprintf(report, MAX_REPORT_LEN+1, "\x1b[%d;%dR",                                         996              snprintf(report, MAX_REPORT_LEN+1, "\x1b[%d;%dR",                                     
 997              vterm_pen_get_y(vterm)+1, vterm_pen_get_x(vterm)+1);                                     997               vterm_pen_get_y(vterm)+1, vterm_pen_get_x(vterm)+1);                                 
 998             break;                                                                                    998              break;                                                                                
 999         }                                                                                             999          }                                                                                         
1000         break;                                                                                       1000          break;                                                                                    
1001     case 'c':                                                                                        1001      case 'c':                                                                                     
1002 #if 0                                                                                                1002  #if 0                                                                                             
1003         if (arg == 0) {                                                                              1003          if (arg == 0) {                                                                           
1004             snprintf(report, MAX_REPORT_LEN+1, "\x1b[%s0c", PACKAGE);                                1004              snprintf(report, MAX_REPORT_LEN+1, "\x1b[%s0c", PACKAGE);                             
1005         }                                                                                            1005          }                                                                                         
1006 #endif                                                                                               1006  #endif                                                                                            
1007         break;                                                                                       1007          break;                                                                                    
1008     }                                                                                                1008      }                                                                                             
1009     if (write(term__.fd_pty_master, report, strlen(report)) < 0) {                                   1009      if (write(term__.fd_pty_master, report, strlen(report)) < 0) {                                
1010         _ERR_                                                                                        1010          _ERR_                                                                                     
1011     }                                                                                                1011      }                                                                                             
1012 }                                                                                                    1012  }

1029 PRIVATE int parse_csi_args(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                               1029  PRIVATE int parse_csi_args(vterm_t *vterm, u_char chr)                                            
1030 {                                                                                                    1030  {                                                                                                 
1031     if ('0' <= chr && chr <= '9') {                                                                  1031      if ('0' <= chr && chr <= '9') {                                                               
1032         // ESC [ 9                                                                                   1032          // ESC [ 9                                                                                
1033         if (csi_arg_idx < MAX_CSI_ARGS) {                                                            1033          if (csi_arg_idx < MAX_CSI_ARGS) {                                                         
1034             csi_args[csi_arg_idx] = (csi_args[csi_arg_idx] * 10) + (chr - '0');                      1034              csi_args[csi_arg_idx] = (csi_args[csi_arg_idx] * 10) + (chr - '0');                   
1035         }                                                                                            1035          }                                                                                         
1036         return 1;                                                                                    1036          return 1;                                                                                 
1037     } else if (chr == ';') {                                                                         1037      } else if (chr == ';') {                                                                      
1038         // ESC [ 9 ;                                                                                 1038          // ESC [ 9 ;                                                                              
1039         /* 引数は MAX_CSI_ARGS 個までサポート */                                                     1039          /* 引数は MAX_CSI_ARGS 個までサポート */                                                                      
1040         if (csi_arg_idx < MAX_CSI_ARGS-1) {                                                          1040          if (csi_arg_idx < MAX_CSI_ARGS-1) {                                                       
1041             csi_arg_idx++;                                                                           1041              csi_arg_idx++;                                                                        
1042         }                                                                                            1042          }                                                                                         
1043         return 1;                                                                                    1043          return 1;                                                                                 
1044     }                                                                                                1044      }                                                                                             
1045     return 0;                                                                                        1045      return 0;                                                                                     
1046 }                                                                                                    1046  }                                                                                                 
1047 PRIVATE int get_csi_arg(int arg_idx)                                                                 1047  PRIVATE int get_csi_arg(int arg_idx)                                                              
1048 {                                                                                                    1048  {                                                                                                 
1049     if (0 <= arg_idx && arg_idx <= csi_arg_idx) {                                                    1049      if (0 <= arg_idx && arg_idx <= csi_arg_idx) {                                                 
1050         return csi_args[arg_idx];                                                                    1050          return csi_args[arg_idx];                                                                 
1051     }                                                                                                1051      }                                                                                             
1052     return 0;                                                                                        1052      return 0;                                                                                     
1053 }                                                                                                    1053  }

  76 void vterm_register_vt_signals(vterm_t *vterm)                                                         76  void vterm_register_vt_signals(vterm_t *vterm)                                                    
  77 {                                                                                                      77  {                                                                                                 
  78     struct vt_mode vtm;                                                                                78      struct vt_mode vtm;                                                                           
  79                                                                                                        79                                                                                                    
  80     // initialize VT state                                                                             80      // initialize VT state                                                                        
  81     vt_state_active = 0;                                                                               81      vt_state_active = 0;                                                                          
  82                                                                                                        82                                                                                                    
  83     signal(SIGUSR1, sig_release_handler);                                                              83      signal(SIGUSR1, sig_release_handler);                                                         
  84     signal(SIGUSR2, sig_acquire_handler);                                                              84      signal(SIGUSR2, sig_acquire_handler);                                                         
  85                                                                                                        85                                                                                                    
  86     vtm.mode = VT_PROCESS;                                                                             86      vtm.mode = VT_PROCESS;                                                                        
  87     vtm.waitv = 0;                                                                                     87      vtm.waitv = 0;                                                                                
  88     vtm.relsig = SIGUSR1;                                                                              88      vtm.relsig = SIGUSR1;                                                                         
  89     vtm.acqsig = SIGUSR2;                                                                              89      vtm.acqsig = SIGUSR2;                                                                         
  90     if (util_privilege_ioctl(0, VT_SETMODE, (void *)&vtm) < 0) {                                       90      if (util_privilege_ioctl(0, VT_SETMODE, (void *)&vtm) < 0) {                                  
  91         _ERR_                                                                                          91          _ERR_                                                                                     
  92         se_printf("ioctl VT_SETMODE");                                                                 92          se_printf("ioctl VT_SETMODE");                                                            
  93     }                                                                                                  93      }                                                                                             
  94 }                                                                                                      94  }                                                                                                 
  95 void vterm_unregister_vt_signals(void)                                                                 95  void vterm_unregister_vt_signals(void)                                                            
  96 {                                                                                                      96  {                                                                                                 
  97     struct vt_mode vtm;                                                                                97      struct vt_mode vtm;                                                                           
  98                                                                                                        98                                                                                                    
  99     signal(SIGUSR1, SIG_DFL);                                                                          99      signal(SIGUSR1, SIG_DFL);                                                                     
 100     signal(SIGUSR2, SIG_DFL);                                                                         100      signal(SIGUSR2, SIG_DFL);                                                                     
 101                                                                                                       101                                                                                                    
 102     vtm.mode = VT_AUTO;                                                                               102      vtm.mode = VT_AUTO;                                                                           
 103     vtm.waitv = 0;                                                                                    103      vtm.waitv = 0;                                                                                
 104     vtm.relsig = 0;                                                                                   104      vtm.relsig = 0;                                                                               
 105     vtm.acqsig = 0;                                                                                   105      vtm.acqsig = 0;                                                                               
 106     if (util_privilege_ioctl(0, VT_SETMODE, (void *)&vtm) < 0) {                                      106      if (util_privilege_ioctl(0, VT_SETMODE, (void *)&vtm) < 0) {                                  
 107         _ERR_                                                                                         107          _ERR_                                                                                     
 108         se_printf("ioctl VT_SETMODE");                                                                108          se_printf("ioctl VT_SETMODE");                                                            
 109     }                                                                                                 109      }                                                                                             
 110 }                                                                                                     110  }

 112 PRIVATE int sig_release_signaled = 0;                                                                 112  PRIVATE int sig_release_signaled = 0;                                                             
 113 PRIVATE int sig_release_replyed = 0;                                                                  113  PRIVATE int sig_release_replyed = 0;                                                              
 114 PRIVATE int sig_acquire_signaled = 0;                                                                 114  PRIVATE int sig_acquire_signaled = 0;                                                             
 115 PRIVATE int sig_acquire_replyed = 0;                                                                  115  PRIVATE int sig_acquire_replyed = 0;                                                              
 116 PRIVATE void sig_release_handler(int signum)                                                          116  PRIVATE void sig_release_handler(int signum)                                                      
 117 {                                                                                                     117  {                                                                                                 
 118     sig_release_signaled++;                                                                           118      sig_release_signaled++;                                                                       
 119     signal(SIGUSR1, sig_release_handler);                                                             119      signal(SIGUSR1, sig_release_handler);                                                         
 120 }                                                                                                     120  }                                                                                                 
 121 PRIVATE void sig_acquire_handler(int signum)                                                          121  PRIVATE void sig_acquire_handler(int signum)                                                      
 122 {                                                                                                     122  {                                                                                                 
 123     sig_acquire_signaled++;                                                                           123      sig_acquire_signaled++;                                                                       
 124     signal(SIGUSR2, sig_acquire_handler);                                                             124      signal(SIGUSR2, sig_acquire_handler);                                                         
 125 }                                                                                                     125  }                                                                                                 
 126 int vterm_reply_sig_release(void)                                                                     126  int vterm_reply_sig_release(void)                                                                 
 127 {                                                                                                     127  {                                                                                                 
 128     if (sig_release_signaled != sig_release_replyed) {                                                128      if (sig_release_signaled != sig_release_replyed) {                                            
 129         sig_release_replyed++;                                                                        129          sig_release_replyed++;                                                                    
 130         vt_state_active = 0;                                                                          130          vt_state_active = 0;                                                                      
 131         if (ioctl(0, VT_RELDISP, 1) < 0) {  // accept vt releasing                                    131          if (ioctl(0, VT_RELDISP, 1) < 0) {  // accept vt releasing                                
 132             _ERR_                                                                                     132              _ERR_                                                                                 
 133             se_printf("ioctl VT_RELDISP");                                                            133              se_printf("ioctl VT_RELDISP");                                                        
 134         }                                                                                             134          }                                                                                         
 135         return 1;                                                                                     135          return 1;                                                                                 
 136     }                                                                                                 136      }                                                                                             
 137     return 0;                                                                                         137      return 0;                                                                                     
 138 }                                                                                                     138  }                                                                                                 
 139 int vterm_reply_sig_acquire(void)                                                                     139  int vterm_reply_sig_acquire(void)                                                                 
 140 {                                                                                                     140  {                                                                                                 
 141     if (sig_acquire_signaled != sig_acquire_replyed) {                                                141      if (sig_acquire_signaled != sig_acquire_replyed) {                                            
 142         sig_acquire_replyed++;                                                                        142          sig_acquire_replyed++;                                                                    
 143         if (ioctl(0, VT_RELDISP, VT_ACKACQ) < 0) {  // accept vt acquisition                          143          if (ioctl(0, VT_RELDISP, VT_ACKACQ) < 0) {  // accept vt acquisition                      
 144             _ERR_                                                                                     144              _ERR_                                                                                 
 145             se_printf("ioctl VT_RELDISP");                                                            145              se_printf("ioctl VT_RELDISP");                                                        
 146         }                                                                                             146          }                                                                                         
 147         vt_state_active = 1;                                                                          147          vt_state_active = 1;                                                                      
 148         return 1;                                                                                     148          return 1;                                                                                 
 149     }                                                                                                 149      }                                                                                             
 150     return 0;                                                                                         150      return 0;                                                                                     
 151 }                                                                                                     151  }

 153 void vterm_send_sigwinch(vterm_t *vterm)                                                              153  void vterm_send_sigwinch(vterm_t *vterm)                                                          
 154 {                                                                                                     154  {                                                                                                 
 155     struct winsize winsz;                                                                             155      struct winsize winsz;                                                                         
 156                                                                                                       156                                                                                                    
 157     winsz.ws_row = vterm->text_lines;                                                                 157      winsz.ws_row = vterm->text_lines;                                                             
 158     winsz.ws_col = vterm->text_columns;                                                               158      winsz.ws_col = vterm->text_columns;                                                           
 159     winsz.ws_xpixel = 0;                                                                              159      winsz.ws_xpixel = 0;                                                                          
 160     winsz.ws_ypixel = 0;                                                                              160      winsz.ws_ypixel = 0;                                                                          
 161 flf_d_printf("row:%2d, col:%2d\n", winsz.ws_row, winsz.ws_col);                                       161  flf_d_printf("row:%2d, col:%2d\n", winsz.ws_row, winsz.ws_col);                                   
 162     // DNU: SIGWINCH is not sent to the client process                                                162      // DNU: SIGWINCH is not sent to the client process                                            
 163     if (ioctl(term__.fd_console, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsz) < 0) {                                           163      if (ioctl(term__.fd_console, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsz) < 0) {                                       
 164         _ERR_                                                                                         164          _ERR_                                                                                     
 165         se_printf("ioctl TIOCSWINSZ");                                                                165          se_printf("ioctl TIOCSWINSZ");                                                            
 166     }                                                                                                 166      }                                                                                             
 167     // DNU: SIGWINCH is not sent to the client process                                                167      // DNU: SIGWINCH is not sent to the client process                                            
 168     if (ioctl(term__.fd_pty_slave, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsz) < 0) {                                         168      if (ioctl(term__.fd_pty_slave, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsz) < 0) {                                     
 169         _ERR_                                                                                         169          _ERR_                                                                                     
 170         se_printf("ioctl TIOCSWINSZ");                                                                170          se_printf("ioctl TIOCSWINSZ");                                                            
 171     }                                                                                                 171      }                                                                                             
 172     // SIGWINCH will be sent to the client process                                                    172      // SIGWINCH will be sent to the client process                                                
 173     if (ioctl(term__.fd_pty_master, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsz) < 0) {                                        173      if (ioctl(term__.fd_pty_master, TIOCSWINSZ, &winsz) < 0) {                                    
 174         _ERR_                                                                                         174          _ERR_                                                                                     
 175         se_printf("ioctl TIOCSWINSZ");                                                                175          se_printf("ioctl TIOCSWINSZ");                                                            
 176     }                                                                                                 176      }                                                                                             
 177     // SIGWINCH will be sent to the client process                                                    177      // SIGWINCH will be sent to the client process                                                
 178 }                                                                                                     178  }

 301 {                                                                                                     301  {                                                                                                 
 302     if (vterm->cursor.blink_counter >= vterm_get_cursor_blink_period(vterm)) {                        302      if (vterm->cursor.blink_counter >= vterm_get_cursor_blink_period(vterm)) {

 307         // [0, blink_count / 2) ==> paint                                                             307          // [0, blink_count / 2) ==> paint

 309     } else {                                                                                          309      } else {

 312     }                                                                                                 312      }

 540 PRIVATE void vterm_paint_char(vterm_t *vterm, int yy, int xx)                                         540  PRIVATE void vterm_paint_char(vterm_t *vterm, int yy, int xx)                                     
 541 {                                                                                                     541  {                                                                                                 
 542     text_char_t *tc_ptr;                                                                              542      text_char_t *tc_ptr;                                                                          
 543     wchar_t ucs21;                                                                                    543      wchar_t ucs21;                                                                                
 544     u_char bfc_idx;                                                                                   544      u_char bfc_idx;                                                                               
 545     u_char flags;                                                                                     545      u_char flags;                                                                                 
 546     rgb15_t bc_rgb;                                                                                   546      rgb15_t bc_rgb;                                                                               
 547     rgb15_t fc_rgb;                                                                                   547      rgb15_t fc_rgb;                                                                               
 548     const u_short *glyph;                                                                             548      const u_short *glyph;                                                                         
 549     bool wide = 0;                                                                                    549      bool wide = 0;                                                                                
 550     int glyph_width_in_pixels;                                                                        550      int glyph_width_in_pixels;                                                                    
 551     int found;                                                                                        551      int found;                                                                                    
 552                                                                                                       552                                                                                                    
 553     tc_ptr = &(vterm->text_buf_to_paint[yy][xx]);                                                     553      tc_ptr = &(vterm->text_buf_to_paint[yy][xx]);                                                 
 554     ucs21 = get_ucs21_from_text_char_t(tc_ptr);                                                       554      ucs21 = get_ucs21_from_text_char_t(tc_ptr);                                                   
 555     flags = get_flags_from_text_char_t(tc_ptr);                                                       555      flags = get_flags_from_text_char_t(tc_ptr);                                                   
 556     bfc_idx = get_bfc_from_text_char_t(tc_ptr);                                                       556      bfc_idx = get_bfc_from_text_char_t(tc_ptr);                                                   
 557     bc_rgb = tc_ptr->bc_rgb;                                                                          557      bc_rgb = tc_ptr->bc_rgb;                                                                      
 558     fc_rgb = tc_ptr->fc_rgb;                                                                          558      fc_rgb = tc_ptr->fc_rgb;                                                                      
 559     if (IS_FLAG_NARROW(flags)) {                                                                      559      if (IS_FLAG_NARROW(flags)) {                                                                  
 560         // narrow character                                                                           560          // narrow character                                                                       
 561         wide = 0;                                                                                     561          wide = 0;                                                                                 
 562     } else if (IS_FLAG_WIDE1(flags)) {                                                                562      } else if (IS_FLAG_WIDE1(flags)) {                                                            
 563         // 1st byte of wide character                                                                 563          // 1st byte of wide character                                                             
 564         wide = 1;                                                                                     564          wide = 1;                                                                                 
 565     } else {                                                                                          565      } else {                                                                                      
 566         // 2nd byte of wide character                                                                 566          // 2nd byte of wide character                                                             
 567         return;     // already painted in 1st byte                                                    567          return;     // already painted in 1st byte                                                
 568     }                                                                                                 568      }                                                                                             
 569 /////mflf_d_printf("yy: %d, xx: %d, ucs21: %04x\n", yy, xx, ucs21);                                   569  /////mflf_d_printf("yy: %d, xx: %d, ucs21: %04x\n", yy, xx, ucs21);                               
 570     font_get_glyph_bitmap(cur_font, ucs21, NULL, &found);                                             570      font_get_glyph_bitmap(cur_font, ucs21, NULL, &found);                                         
 571     if (found == 0) {                                                                                 571      if (found == 0) {                                                                             
 572         bfc_idx ^= COLOR_UNKNOWN_GLYPH;                                                               572          bfc_idx ^= COLOR_UNKNOWN_GLYPH;                                                           
 573         fc_rgb = rgb15_from_color_idx(COLOR_UNKNOWN_GLYPH);                                           573          fc_rgb = rgb15_from_color_idx(COLOR_UNKNOWN_GLYPH);                                       
 574     }                                                                                                 574      }                                                                                             
 575     fb__.driver->bpp_paint_char_box(xx, yy, ucs21, wide,                                              575      fb__.driver->bpp_paint_char_box(xx, yy, ucs21, wide,                                          
 576      BC_FROM_BFC(bfc_idx), FC_FROM_BFC(bfc_idx), bc_rgb, fc_rgb);                                     576       BC_FROM_BFC(bfc_idx), FC_FROM_BFC(bfc_idx), bc_rgb, fc_rgb);                                 
 577 }                                                                                                     577  }

 963 void set_text_char_t(text_char_t *text_char, wchar_t ucs32, pen_t *pen, u_char flags)                 963  void set_text_char_t(text_char_t *text_char, wchar_t ucs32, pen_t *pen, u_char flags)             
 964 {                                                                                                     964  {                                                                                                 
 965     text_char->bfc_flags_ucs21 =                                                                      965      text_char->bfc_flags_ucs21 =                                                                  
 966      ((BFC_FROM_BC_FC(pen_get_bgc_idx(pen), pen_get_fgc_idx(pen)) << 24)  & TEXT_CHAR_T_BFC)          966       ((BFC_FROM_BC_FC(pen_get_bgc_idx(pen), pen_get_fgc_idx(pen)) << 24)  & TEXT_CHAR_T_BFC)      
 967       | ((flags << 16) & TEXT_CHAR_T_FLAGS) | MIN_MAX(0x000000, ucs32, TEXT_CHAR_T_UCS21);            967        | ((flags << 16) & TEXT_CHAR_T_FLAGS) | MIN_MAX(0x000000, ucs32, TEXT_CHAR_T_UCS21);        
 968     text_char->bc_rgb = pen_get_bc_rgb(pen);                                                          968      text_char->bc_rgb = pen_get_bc_rgb(pen);                                                      
 969     text_char->fc_rgb = pen_get_fc_rgb(pen);                                                          969      text_char->fc_rgb = pen_get_fc_rgb(pen);                                                      
 970 }                                                                                                     970  }                                                                                                 
 971 void set_flags_to_text_char_t(text_char_t *text_char, u_char flags)                                   971  void set_flags_to_text_char_t(text_char_t *text_char, u_char flags)

 992 }                                                                                                     992  }

1005     snprintf(buf, 15+1, "%2d:%2d:%02x:%06x",                                                         1005      snprintf(buf, 15+1, "%2d:%2d:%02x:%06x",

1007      FC_FROM_BFC(get_bfc_from_text_char_t(text_char)),                                               1007       FC_FROM_BFC(get_bfc_from_text_char_t(text_char)),                                            
1008      get_flags_from_text_char_t(text_char),                                                          1008       get_flags_from_text_char_t(text_char),                                                       
1009      get_ucs21_from_text_char_t(text_char));                                                         1009       get_ucs21_from_text_char_t(text_char));
